sentence.traditional: 他十二點才到。
sentence.simplified: 他十二点才到。
sentence.pinyin: Tā shí'èr diǎn cái dào.
sentence.english: He did not arrive until twelve.

sentence.traditional: 十二點他才到。
sentence.simplified: 十二点他才到。
sentence.pinyin: Shí'èr diǎn tā cái dào.
sentence.english: He did not arrive until twelve.

sentence.traditional: 十二點才到。
sentence.simplified: 十二点才到。
sentence.pinyin: Shí'èr diǎn cái dào.
sentence.english: Did not arrive until twelve.

repairs.note: 就 would say twelve was earlier than expected; it was later, so use 才.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 才 because twelve is later than the expected nine.

items.prompt: You got up at six this morning, which is early, so you were not late.

promptZh.traditional: 你今天早上六點起床，時間很早，所以沒遲到。
promptZh.simplified: 你今天早上六点起床，时间很早，所以没迟到。

repairs.note: 才 would say six was later than expected; six is early, so use 就.
已經 says “already”, not “as early as”.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 才 leaves 六點起床, which does not say “as early as six”.
items.hint: Six is earlier than usual.

result.traditional: 我早上六點就起床，所以沒遲到。
result.simplified: 我早上六点就起床，所以没迟到。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng, suǒyǐ méi chídào.
result.english: I got up at six, so I was not late.

items.title: Grammar 10–11 · I Want to Live in a Clean Place

dialogue.title: 短文 · 我要住在乾淨的地方

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 山本良介今天早上出門的時候，看見房間門口有一個袋子。他把袋子打開，發現裡面都是垃圾。下樓的時候，樓梯上也有垃圾。他想：「是誰把垃圾丟在這裡的？好髒啊！」他知道應該先把垃圾丟到垃圾桶，再去上課，可是他很急，不想在開學的第一天就遲到，所以什麼都沒做就去上課了。
lines.simplified: 山本良介今天早上出门的时候，看见房间门口有一个袋子。他把袋子打开，发现里面都是垃圾。下楼的时候，楼梯上也有垃圾。他想：「是谁把垃圾丢在这里的？好脏啊！」他知道应该先把垃圾丢到垃圾桶，再去上课，可是他很急，不想在开学的第一天就迟到，所以什么都没做就去上课了。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè jīntiān zǎoshang chūmén de shíhou, kànjiàn fángjiān ménkǒu yǒu yí ge dàizi. Tā bǎ dàizi dǎkāi, fāxiàn lǐmiàn dōu shì lèsè. Xià lóu de shíhou, lóutī shàng yě yǒu lèsè. Tā xiǎng: 「Shì shéi bǎ lèsè diū zài zhèlǐ de? Hǎo zāng a!」 Tā zhīdào yīnggāi xiān bǎ lèsè diū dào lèsè tǒng, zài qù shàngkè, kěshì tā hěn jí, bù xiǎng zài kāixué de dì yī tiān jiù chídào, suǒyǐ shénme dōu méi zuò jiù qù shàngkè le.
lines.english: When Yamamoto Ryosuke went out this morning, he saw a bag at the door of his dorm room. He opened the bag and found that there was nothing but garbage in it. When he went downstairs, there was also garbage on the stairs. "Who dumped the garbage here? It's so dirty!" he thought. He knew that he should have thrown the garbage to the trash can before attending class, but he was in a hurry because he did not want to be late on the first day of school. Therefore, he went to class without doing anything.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 中午良介回去的時候，覺得宿舍裡的空氣很不好。因為垃圾的味道很臭，而且到處都有小蟲子在飛，他就趕快把全部的垃圾都丟了。良介記得小時候媽媽告訴過他，吃完飯以後要洗碗、倒垃圾。星期六起床以後，不但要打掃房間，也得把髒衣服洗一洗。這些家事做完了以後，住在房子裡的每一個人才會覺得舒服。要是客人或是鄰居要來，也不用擔心家裡太髒。
lines.simplified: 中午良介回去的时候，觉得宿舍里的空气很不好。因为垃圾的味道很臭，而且到处都有小虫子在飞，他就赶快把全部的垃圾都丢了。良介记得小时候妈妈告诉过他，吃完饭以后要洗碗、倒垃圾。星期六起床以后，不但要打扫房间，也得把脏衣服洗一洗。这些家事做完了以后，住在房子里的每一个人才会觉得舒服。要是客人或是邻居要来，也不用担心家里太脏。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ Liángjiè huíqù de shíhou, juéde sùshè lǐ de kōngqì hěn bù hǎo. Yīnwèi lèsè de wèidào hěn chòu, érqiě dàochù dōu yǒu xiǎo chóngzi zài fēi, tā jiù gǎnkuài bǎ quánbù de lèsè dōu diū le. Liángjiè jìde xiǎoshíhou māma gàosu guò tā, chī wán fàn yǐhòu yào xǐ wǎn, dào lèsè. Xīngqíliù qǐchuáng yǐhòu, búdàn yào dǎsǎo fángjiān, yě děi bǎ zāng yīfu xǐ yī xǐ. Zhèxiē jiāshì zuò wán le yǐhòu, zhù zài fángzi lǐ de měi yí ge rén cái huì juéde shūfu. Yàoshi kèrén huòshì línjū yào lái, yě búyòng dānxīn jiā lǐ tài zāng.
lines.english: At noon, when Ryosuke went back to the dormitory, he felt that the air in the dormitory was not good. The smell of the garbage was stinky, and there were insects flying everywhere, so he immediately threw all the garbage away. Ryosuke remembered that when he was a child, his mother had told him to wash the dishes and take out the garbage after finishing a meal. After getting up on Saturday, he not only had to clean his room but also had to wash the dirty clothes. After this housework was done, everyone living in the house would feel comfortable. If a guest or a neighbor came to visit, there was no need to worry that the house was too dirty, either.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 晚上良介吃完飯，回宿舍的時候，他看見牆上寫著「不要亂丟垃圾」，可是地上還是有一些垃圾。他想，要是每個人都覺得打掃是別人的事，不久以後，這個地方就會又髒又亂，沒有人想住了。
lines.simplified: 晚上良介吃完饭，回宿舍的时候，他看见墙上写着「不要乱丢垃圾」，可是地上还是有一些垃圾。他想，要是每个人都觉得打扫是别人的事，不久以后，这个地方就会又脏又乱，没有人想住了。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshang Liángjiè chī wán fàn, huí sùshè de shíhou, tā kànjiàn qiáng shàng xiězhe 「Búyào luàn diū lèsè」, kěshì dìshàng háishì yǒu yìxiē lèsè. Tā xiǎng, yàoshi měi ge rén dōu juéde dǎsǎo shì biérén de shì, bùjiǔ yǐhòu, zhège dìfāng jiù huì yòu zāng yòu luàn, méiyǒu rén xiǎng zhù le.
lines.english: After eating in the evening, Ryosuke went back to the dormitory. He saw "No Littering" written on the wall. However, there was still some garbage on the ground. He thought that if everyone considers cleaning to be other people's business, this place would be dirty and messy soon after, and nobody wants to live in.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with 在 and 到
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where something ends up: 丟在浴室裡、拿到桌子上.
grammarPages.explanation: 把字句的動詞後面用「在」表示動作後東西的位置，用「到」表示動作到達的地方：丟在浴室裡、拿到桌子上。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Noun + Verb + 在 / 到 + Place

text.traditional: 孩子把髒衣服丟在浴室裡。
text.simplified: 孩子把脏衣服丢在浴室里。
text.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zāng yīfu diū zài yùshì lǐ.
text.english: The child threw the dirty clothes in the bathroom.

text.traditional: 你怎麼沒把地址寫在信封上呢？
text.simplified: 你怎么没把地址写在信封上呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme méi bǎ dìzhǐ xiě zài xìnfēng shàng ne?
text.english: How come you didn't write the address on the envelope?

text.traditional: 我覺得把錢放在銀行比放在家裡安全得多。
text.simplified: 我觉得把钱放在银行比放在家里安全得多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián fàng zài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán de duō.
text.english: I think putting money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

text.traditional: 媽媽把蛋糕拿到廚房的桌子上。
text.simplified: 妈妈把蛋糕拿到厨房的桌子上。
text.pinyin: Māma bǎ dàngāo ná dào chúfáng de zhuōzi shàng.
text.english: Mom took the cake to the kitchen table.

text.traditional: 你不可以把球踢到馬路上，太危險了。
text.simplified: 你不可以把球踢到马路上，太危险了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù kěyǐ bǎ qiú tī dào mǎlù shàng, tài wéixiǎn le.
text.english: You must not kick the ball onto the road; it's too dangerous.

text.traditional: 李小姐把生日卡片寄到男朋友家。
text.simplified: 李小姐把生日卡片寄到男朋友家。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě bǎ shēngrì kǎpiàn jì dào nánpéngyou jiā.
text.english: Miss Li mailed the birthday card to her boyfriend's home.

items.question: 地方放在「V在/到」前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在後面：丟在浴室裡、拿到桌子上。
items.wrongTraditional: 孩子把髒衣服在浴室裡丟。
items.wrongSimplified: 孩子把脏衣服在浴室里丢。

right.traditional: 孩子把髒衣服丟在浴室裡。
right.simplified: 孩子把脏衣服丢在浴室里。
right.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zāng yīfu diū zài yùshì lǐ.
right.english: The child threw the dirty clothes in the bathroom.

items.question: 地址用「寫在」還是「寫到」？
items.answer: 地址留在信封上，用「寫在」；東西送到一個地方，用「寄到」。
items.wrongTraditional: 你怎麼沒把地址寫到信封上呢？
items.wrongSimplified: 你怎么没把地址写到信封上呢？

right.traditional: 你怎麼沒把地址寫在信封上呢？
right.simplified: 你怎么没把地址写在信封上呢？
right.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme méi bǎ dìzhǐ xiě zài xìnfēng shàng ne?
right.english: How come you didn't write the address on the envelope?

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！東西留在浴室裡，用「丟在」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「到」說動作到達的地方；這裡說東西最後在浴室裡，用「在」。

items.prompt: Your watch is on your friend's wrist. Ask why.

promptZh.traditional: 你的手錶在朋友的手上。問他為什麼。
promptZh.simplified: 你的手表在朋友的手上。问他为什么。

result.traditional: 為什麼你把我的手錶戴在你的手上？
result.simplified: 为什么你把我的手表戴在你的手上？
result.pinyin: Wèishénme nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒubiǎo dài zài nǐ de shǒu shàng?
result.english: Why are you wearing my watch on your wrist?

repairs.note: 放在 would mean setting it down, not wearing it.
拿在 means holding it in your hand, not wearing it on your wrist.
帶在 means carrying it with you, not wearing it.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 戴在 for something you wear on your wrist.

items.prompt: The student went home, but his textbook is still in the classroom.

promptZh.traditional: 那個學生回家了，課本還在教室裡。
promptZh.simplified: 那个学生回家了，课本还在教室里。

result.traditional: 那個學生把課本放在教室裡，忘了帶回家了。
result.simplified: 那个学生把课本放在教室里，忘了带回家了。
result.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng bǎ kèběn fàng zài jiàoshì lǐ, wàng le dài huí jiā le.
result.english: The student left his textbook in the classroom and forgot to bring it home.

repairs.note: He forgot to bring it home, so it is not at home.
The textbook is in the classroom, not at home.
You do not write a textbook into a place; it stays there: 放在.
教室裡 is the place; 放在 comes before it.
放在 is the verb; the place 教室裡 comes after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 放在 + place for where the textbook stays.

items.prompt: The room smells bad because the garbage is all in the room.

promptZh.traditional: 房間的味道不好，因為垃圾都在房間裡。
promptZh.simplified: 房间的味道不好，因为垃圾都在房间里。

result.traditional: 室友常常把垃圾丟在房間裡，所以房間的味道真不好。
result.simplified: 室友常常把垃圾丢在房间里，所以房间的味道真不好。
result.pinyin: Shìyǒu chángcháng bǎ lèsè diū zài fángjiān lǐ, suǒyǐ fángjiān de wèidào zhēn bù hǎo.
result.english: My roommate often throws garbage in the room, so the room smells really bad.

repairs.note: The smell is in the room; the garbage is in the room.
Garbage in a bag would not make the room smell.
You do not wear garbage; use 丟在.
房間裡 is the place; 丟在 comes before it.
丟在 is the verb; the place 房間裡 comes after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 丟在 + 房間裡.

items.prompt: During the exam, phones may not be on the desk. His bag is beside him. Ask him to put his phone away.

promptZh.traditional: 考試的時候，手機不可以放在桌子上。他的袋子在旁邊。請他放好。
promptZh.simplified: 考试的时候，手机不可以放在桌子上。他的袋子在旁边。请他放好。

segments.traditional: 考試的時候，不可以把手機放在桌子上，請你
segments.simplified: 考试的时候，不可以把手机放在桌子上，请你

result.traditional: 考試的時候，不可以把手機放在桌子上，請你把手機放到袋子裡。
result.simplified: 考试的时候，不可以把手机放在桌子上，请你把手机放到袋子里。
result.pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhou, bù kěyǐ bǎ shǒujī fàng zài zhuōzi shàng, qǐng nǐ bǎ shǒujī fàng dào dàizi lǐ.
result.english: During the exam, phones may not be on the desk; please put your phone in your bag.

repairs.note: You do not write a phone into a bag; use 放到.
帶去 needs a destination; the phone goes into the bag: 放到.
放到 is the verb; 把手機 comes first.
袋子裡 is the place; 把手機 comes first.
把手機 is the object; 放到 comes after it.
袋子裡 is the place; 放到 comes before it.
把手機 is the object; the place 袋子裡 ends the phrase.
放到 is the verb; the place 袋子裡 comes after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 放到 + 袋子裡.

items.prompt: A man was hurt on the road. The police came.

promptZh.traditional: 有一個人在馬路上受傷了。警察來了。
promptZh.simplified: 有一个人在马路上受伤了。警察来了。

result.traditional: 警察把那個受傷的人送到醫院。
result.simplified: 警察把那个受伤的人送到医院。
result.pinyin: Jǐngchá bǎ nàge shòushāng de rén sòng dào yīyuàn.
result.english: The police took the injured man to the hospital.

repairs.note: A hurt person goes to the hospital, not the school.
A hurt person goes to the hospital, not the school.
A hurt person goes to the hospital, not home.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 送到醫院.

items.prompt: Drinks are not allowed in the classroom. Say you must not bring drinks into the classroom.

promptZh.traditional: 教室裡不可以喝飲料。你不可以帶飲料進去。
promptZh.simplified: 教室里不可以喝饮料。你不可以带饮料进去。

sentence.traditional: 你不可以把飲料帶到教室裡。
sentence.simplified: 你不可以把饮料带到教室里。
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ bù kěyǐ bǎ yǐnliào dài dào jiàoshì lǐ.
sentence.english: You must not bring drinks into the classroom.

repairs.note: 喝完 means finish the drink; the rule is about bringing it into the classroom.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 把 + 飲料 + 帶到 + 教室裡.

items.prompt: The book is at school now. When he left, it was in his bag. Say it with 把.

promptZh.traditional: 書現在在學校。他出門的時候，書在他的袋子裡。用「把」說。
promptZh.simplified: 书现在在学校。他出门的时候，书在他的袋子里。用「把」说。

sentence.traditional: 他把書帶到學校了。
sentence.simplified: 他把书带到学校了。
sentence.pinyin: Tā bǎ shū dài dào xuéxiào le.
sentence.english: He brought the book to school.

repairs.note: 帶在學校 is not used; 帶到 marks the place reached.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 帶到 for the place he brought the book to.

items.prompt: The cup is in his hand and the table is empty. Ask him to put it down.

promptZh.traditional: 杯子在他手上，桌子上沒有東西。請他放好。
promptZh.simplified: 杯子在他手上，桌子上没有东西。请他放好。

sentence.traditional: 請你把杯子放在桌子上。
sentence.simplified: 请你把杯子放在桌子上。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ bēizi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentence.english: Please put the cup on the table.

sentence.traditional: 把杯子放在桌子上。
sentence.simplified: 把杯子放在桌子上。
sentence.pinyin: Bǎ bēizi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentence.english: Put the cup on the table.

repairs.note: Do not throw the cup; put it down with 放在.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 放在 + 桌子上.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what result follows only when a condition is met: 才不會覺得冷、才能寫得好看.
grammarPages.explanation: 「才」在第二個句子裡，表示前面的條件或原因成立以後，才有後面的結果。第一個句子常用「得、要、為了、因為」。
grammarPages.pattern: Condition + 才 + Result

columns.pinyin: nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu
columns.meaning: you'd better put on another layer

columns.pinyin: nǐ děi měi tiān liànxí xiě zì
columns.meaning: you have to practice writing every day

text.traditional: 他昨天是因為生病才沒來上課。
text.simplified: 他昨天是因为生病才没来上课。
text.pinyin: Tā zuótiān shì yīnwèi shēngbìng cái méi lái shàngkè.
text.english: Yesterday he missed class only because he was sick.

text.traditional: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不會覺得冷。
text.simplified: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不会觉得冷。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu, cái bú huì juéde lěng.
text.english: You'd better put on another piece of clothing so you won't feel cold.

text.traditional: 你得每天練習寫字，字才能寫得好看。
text.simplified: 你得每天练习写字，字才能写得好看。
text.pinyin: Nǐ děi měi tiān liànxí xiě zì, zì cái néng xiě de hǎokàn.
text.english: You have to practice writing every day; only then can your characters look good.

items.question: 「才」放在結果前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在結果前面：才不會覺得冷、才能寫得好看。
items.wrongTraditional: 你最好再穿一件衣服，不會才覺得冷。
items.wrongSimplified: 你最好再穿一件衣服，不会才觉得冷。

right.traditional: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不會覺得冷。
right.simplified: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不会觉得冷。
right.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu, cái bú huì juéde lěng.
right.english: You'd better put on another piece of clothing so you won't feel cold.

words.pinyin: nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu
words.meaning: you'd better put on another layer

items.question: 第一個句子常用哪些詞？
items.answer: 常用「得、要、為了、因為」：你得先買票、因為生病才沒來。
items.wrongTraditional: 你生病因為才沒來上課。
items.wrongSimplified: 你生病因为才没来上课。

right.traditional: 他昨天是因為生病才沒來上課。
right.simplified: 他昨天是因为生病才没来上课。
right.pinyin: Tā zuótiān shì yīnwèi shēngbìng cái méi lái shàngkè.
right.english: Yesterday he missed class only because he was sick.

words.meaning: it was because he was sick

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！前面的條件成立，後面的結果才成立，用「才」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「就」表示結果很快發生；這裡是「才不會」，用「才」。

items.prompt: You cannot enter the movies without a ticket. You have to buy one first.

promptZh.traditional: 沒有票不能進去。你得先買票。
promptZh.simplified: 没有票不能进去。你得先买票。

result.traditional: 你得先買票，才能進去。
result.simplified: 你得先买票，才能进去。
result.pinyin: Nǐ děi xiān mǎi piào, cái néng jìnqù.
result.english: You have to buy a ticket first; only then can you go in.

repairs.note: You are going into the movies, not coming out.
This says you cannot enter, the opposite.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 才 to introduce the result that depends on buying a ticket.

items.prompt: You have an 8 a.m. Chinese class tomorrow. Say why you should sleep earlier.

promptZh.traditional: 明天早上八點有中文課。你應該早一點兒睡覺。
promptZh.simplified: 明天早上八点有中文课。你应该早一点儿睡觉。

sentence.traditional: 你應該早一點兒睡覺，才不會遲到。
sentence.simplified: 你应该早一点儿睡觉，才不会迟到。
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zǎo yìdiǎnr shuìjiào, cái bú huì chídào.
sentence.english: You should go to bed earlier so you will not be late.

sentence.traditional: 早一點兒睡覺，才不會遲到。
sentence.simplified: 早一点儿睡觉，才不会迟到。
sentence.pinyin: Zǎo yìdiǎnr shuìjiào, cái bú huì chídào.
sentence.english: Go to bed earlier so you will not be late.

repairs.note: 就會 says it will happen anyway; you want the purpose, so use 才不會.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 才不會 + 遲到.

items.prompt: A friend asks why you did not buy him a gift. You were very busy.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友問你為什麼沒買禮物給他。你很忙。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友问你为什么没买礼物给他。你很忙。

result.traditional: 因為我太忙，才沒買禮物給你的。
result.simplified: 因为我太忙，才没买礼物给你的。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ tài máng, cái méi mǎi lǐwù gěi nǐ de.
result.english: It was because I was too busy that I did not buy you a gift.

repairs.note: 所以 introduces a result, not the reason; start with 因為我.
可是 marks contrast, not the reason after 因為; use 太忙.
Use 太忙 after 因為我; 我忙 repeats the subject and leaves out 太.
太忙 is the reason; 因為我 comes first.
因為我 starts the reason; 太忙 follows it.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 因為 in the first clause.

items.prompt: Your Chinese is not good. Ask him to practice more.

promptZh.traditional: 中文不好。請他多練習。
promptZh.simplified: 中文不好。请他多练习。

sentence.traditional: 你得多練習，中文才會好。
sentence.simplified: 你得多练习，中文才会好。
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō liànxí, Zhōngwén cái huì hǎo.
sentence.english: You have to practice more; only then will your Chinese be good.

sentence.traditional: 中文你得多練習，才會好。
sentence.simplified: 中文你得多练习，才会好。
sentence.pinyin: Zhōngwén nǐ děi duō liànxí, cái huì hǎo.
sentence.english: You have to practice Chinese more; only then will it be good.

repairs.note: 才不 would say Chinese will not be good, the opposite.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 得 in the condition and 才 in the result.

items.prompt: Which 才 does each sentence use?

promptZh.traditional: 這些句子是哪一種「才」？
promptZh.simplified: 这些句子是哪一种「才」？

sentence.traditional: 他昨天晚上十二點才回家。
sentence.simplified: 他昨天晚上十二点才回家。
sentence.pinyin: Tā zuótiān wǎnshàng shí'èr diǎn cái huí jiā.
sentence.english: He did not get home until twelve last night.

cards.note: 十二點 is later than expected, so 才 follows the time.

sentence.traditional: 他明天才回來。
sentence.simplified: 他明天才回来。
sentence.pinyin: Tā míngtiān cái huílái.
sentence.english: He will not be back until tomorrow.

cards.note: He will not be back until tomorrow: 才 after the time shows it is later than expected.

sentence.traditional: 你要先寫完功課，才可以看電視。
sentence.simplified: 你要先写完功课，才可以看电视。
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ yào xiān xiě wán gōngkè, cái kěyǐ kàn diànshì.
sentence.english: You have to finish your homework first; only then can you watch TV.

cards.note: Finishing homework is the condition; 才 introduces the result.

sentence.traditional: 你要多運動，身體才會好。
sentence.simplified: 你要多运动，身体才会好。
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō yùndòng, shēntǐ cái huì hǎo.
sentence.english: You need to exercise more; only then will your body be healthy.

cards.note: More exercise is the condition; 才 introduces the result.

items.successNote: Time + 才 means later than expected. Condition + 才 means only then.

items.title: Grammar 1–7 · I Want to Rent a House

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （良介去看房子，他和可欣到了公寓的門口，房東王太太剛好出來了。）
lines.simplified: （良介去看房子，他和可欣到了公寓的门口，房东王太太刚好出来了。）
lines.pinyin: （Liángjiè qù kàn fángzi, tā hé Kěxīn dào le gōngyù de ménkǒu, fángdōng Wáng tàitai gānghǎo chūlái le.）
lines.english: (Ryosuke goes to view an apartment. When he and Kexin arrive at the entrance of the building, the landlady, Mrs. Wang, happens to come out.)

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 王太太，您好。我是陳可欣。這位是我的朋友山本良介，我陪他來看房子。
lines.simplified: 王太太，您好。我是陈可欣。这位是我的朋友山本良介，我陪他来看房子。
lines.pinyin: Wáng tàitai, nín hǎo. Wǒ shì Chén Kěxīn. Zhè wèi shì wǒ de péngyou Shānběn Liángjiè, wǒ péi tā lái kàn fángzi.
lines.english: Mrs. Wang, hello. I'm Kexin Chen. This is my friend Ryosuke Yamamoto. I'm accompanying him to look at the apartment.

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 你們好！這棟公寓一共有六層，我要出租的房子在四樓，我們一起上去看看吧！
lines.simplified: 你们好！这栋公寓一共有六层，我要出租的房子在四楼，我们一起上去看看吧！
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo! Zhè dòng gōngyù yígòng yǒu liù céng, wǒ yào chūzū de fángzi zài sì lóu, wǒmen yìqǐ shàngqù kànkan ba!
lines.english: Hello! This apartment building has six floors in total. The apartment I want to rent out is on the fourth floor. Let's go up and take a look!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好的。對了，請問有家具嗎？
lines.simplified: 好的。对了，请问有家具吗？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Duì le, qǐngwèn yǒu jiājù ma?
lines.english: OK. By the way, may I ask if there is furniture?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 有。臥室有床、書桌、椅子、沙發，還有一個大衣櫃，可以掛很多衣服，而且冰箱、洗衣機都是新的。
lines.simplified: 有。卧室有床、书桌、椅子、沙发，还有一个大衣柜，可以挂很多衣服，而且冰箱、洗衣机都是新的。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu. Wòshì yǒu chuáng, shūzhuō, yǐzi, shāfā, hái yǒu yí ge dà yīguì, kěyǐ guà hěn duō yīfu, érqiě bīngxiāng, xǐyījī dōu shì xīn de.
lines.english: Yes. The bedroom has a bed, a desk, a chair and a sofa, and there is also a large closet for hanging many clothes. The refrigerator and washing machine are both new.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （三人到了四樓）
lines.simplified: （三人到了四楼）
lines.pinyin: （Sān rén dào le sì lóu.）
lines.english: (The three of them reach the fourth floor.)

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 請進！我給你們介紹介紹。這是客廳，右邊是廚房，臥室和浴室在那邊。
lines.simplified: 请进！我给你们介绍介绍。这是客厅，右边是厨房，卧室和浴室在那边。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng jìn! Wǒ gěi nǐmen jièshào jièshào. Zhè shì kètīng, yòubiān shì chúfáng, wòshì hé yùshì zài nàbiān.
lines.english: Please come in! Let me show you around. This is the living room; the kitchen is on the right; the bedroom and bathroom are over there.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 房間看起來很好！請問附近有超級市場嗎？
lines.simplified: 房间看起来很好！请问附近有超级市场吗？
lines.pinyin: Fángjiān kànqǐlái hěn hǎo! Qǐngwèn fùjìn yǒu chāojí shìchǎng ma?
lines.english: The room looks great! May I ask if there is a supermarket nearby?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 有啊！從這裡出去，走五分鐘就有超市和便利商店了。
lines.simplified: 有啊！从这里出去，走五分钟就有超市和便利商店了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu a! Cóng zhèlǐ chūqù, zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù yǒu chāoshì hé biànlì shāngdiàn le.
lines.english: Yes! Go out from here, and a five-minute walk brings you to a supermarket and a convenience store.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這裡有網路嗎？
lines.simplified: 这里有网路吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu wǎnglù ma?
lines.english: Is there internet here?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 沒有，我可以替你裝網路，可是每個月的費用要自己付。
lines.simplified: 没有，我可以替你装网路，可是每个月的费用要自己付。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ kěyǐ tì nǐ zhuāng wǎnglù, kěshì měi ge yuè de fèiyòng yào zìjǐ fù.
lines.english: No. I can set up the internet for you, but you have to pay the monthly fee yourself.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 聽起來不錯。請問房租一個月多少錢？
lines.simplified: 听起来不错。请问房租一个月多少钱？
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái búcuò. Qǐngwèn fángzū yí ge yuè duōshao qián?
lines.english: That sounds good. May I ask how much the rent is per month?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 一個月一萬五千塊，不包括水費、電費，還要兩個月的押金。
lines.simplified: 一个月一万五千块，不包括水费、电费，还要两个月的押金。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yuè yí wàn wǔqiān kuài, bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi, hái yào liǎng ge yuè de yājīn.
lines.english: It's $15,000 a month, not including water and electricity, and a two-month deposit is also required.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 好，我先跟我朋友討論一下，請您等一會兒。
lines.simplified: 好，我先跟我朋友讨论一下，请您等一会儿。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xiān gēn wǒ péngyou tǎolùn yíxià, qǐng nín děng yìhuǐr.
lines.english: OK. Let me discuss it with my friend first. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 你覺得這裡怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你觉得这里怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhèlǐ zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What do you think of this place?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這邊的環境不錯，可是付了房租以後，我的獎學金就只剩一萬塊了。
lines.simplified: 这边的环境不错，可是付了房租以后，我的奖学金就只剩一万块了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèbiān de huánjìng búcuò, kěshì fù le fángzū yǐhòu, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn jiù zhǐ shèng yí wàn kuài le.
lines.english: The environment here is nice, but after paying the rent, I'll have only $10,000 of my scholarship left.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 這樣的房子都不便宜。你問問王太太，房租能不能便宜一點兒。
lines.simplified: 这样的房子都不便宜。你问问王太太，房租能不能便宜一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de fángzi dōu bù piányi. Nǐ wènwen Wáng tàitai, fángzū néng bu néng piányi yìdiǎnr.
lines.english: Apartments like this are all expensive. Ask Mrs. Wang if the rent can be a little cheaper.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 王太太，這個公寓我很滿意，可是房租有一點兒貴，可以便宜一點兒嗎？
lines.simplified: 王太太，这个公寓我很满意，可是房租有一点儿贵，可以便宜一点儿吗？
lines.pinyin: Wáng tàitai, zhège gōngyù wǒ hěn mǎnyì, kěshì fángzū yǒu yìdiǎnr guì, kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎnr ma?
lines.english: Mrs. Wang, I'm very satisfied with this apartment, but the rent is a little expensive. Can it be a little cheaper?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 我想想……你是留學生吧？我兒子也去法國留學了，我知道外國人找房子不太容易。
lines.simplified: 我想想……你是留学生吧？我儿子也去法国留学了，我知道外国人找房子不太容易。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngxiang…… Nǐ shì liúxuéshēng ba? Wǒ érzi yě qù Fǎguó liúxué le, wǒ zhīdào wàiguórén zhǎo fángzi bú tài róngyì.
lines.english: Let me think... You're an international student, right? My son also went to study in France. I know it's not easy for foreigners to find an apartment.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 對啊！我看了好幾個地方，有的環境很好，可是房租太貴；有些房東一看我是外國人，就不願意租給我了。
lines.simplified: 对啊！我看了好几个地方，有的环境很好，可是房租太贵；有些房东一看我是外国人，就不愿意租给我了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a! Wǒ kàn le hǎo jǐ ge dìfāng, yǒude huánjìng hěn hǎo, kěshì fángzū tài guì; yǒuxiē fángdōng yí kàn wǒ shì wàiguórén, jiù bú yuànyì zū gěi wǒ le.
lines.english: That's right! I've looked at several places. Some have a nice environment but the rent is too high; some landlords, as soon as they see that I'm a foreigner, are unwilling to rent to me.

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 好吧！你那麼喜歡，那就一個月一萬兩千塊。
lines.simplified: 好吧！你那么喜欢，那就一个月一万两千块。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba! Nǐ nàme xǐhuan, nà jiù yí ge yuè yí wàn liǎngqiān kuài.
lines.english: All right! Since you like it so much, I'll make it $12,000 a month.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太好了！謝謝您，我決定租半年。下個星期一可以簽約嗎？
lines.simplified: 太好了！谢谢您，我决定租半年。下个星期一可以签约吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie nín, wǒ juédìng zū bàn nián. Xià ge xīngqíyī kěyǐ qiānyuē ma?
lines.english: Great! Thank you. I've decided to rent it for half a year. Can we sign the lease next Monday?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 可以，你過來簽約的時候請帶護照、房租和兩個月的押金。簽約以後會給你鑰匙，你就可以搬進來了。
lines.simplified: 可以，你过来签约的时候请带护照、房租和两个月的押金。签约以后会给你钥匙，你就可以搬进来了。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, nǐ guòlái qiānyuē de shíhou qǐng dài hùzhào, fángzū hé liǎng ge yuè de yājīn. Qiānyuē yǐhòu huì gěi nǐ yàoshi, nǐ jiù kěyǐ bān jìnlái le.
lines.english: Yes. When you come to sign the lease, please bring your passport, the rent and a two-month deposit. After you sign, I'll give you the keys and you can move in.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether movement comes toward you or goes away: come up, go down, come in, go out.
grammarPages.explanation: 「來」表示動作朝向說話的人，「去」表示動作離開說話的人。方向動詞和「來／去」結合成「上來、上去、下來、下去」等，說明動作的方向。
grammarPages.pattern: Directional verb + 來 / 去

text.traditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上來。
text.simplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài èr lóu, qǐng shànglái.
text.english: My room is on the second floor. Please come up.

text.traditional: 爸爸有事找你，你趕快過去。
text.simplified: 爸爸有事找你，你赶快过去。
text.pinyin: Bàba yǒu shì zhǎo nǐ, nǐ gǎnkuài guòqù.
text.english: Dad is looking for you. Hurry over.

text.traditional: 他出去一會兒，五分鐘以後就回來。
text.simplified: 他出去一会儿，五分钟以后就回来。
text.pinyin: Tā chūqù yìhuǐr, wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù huílái.
text.english: He went out for a while; he will be back in five minutes.

items.question: You are upstairs; your friend is downstairs. Do you say 請上來 or 請上去?
items.answer: 說話的人在樓上，用「上來」：請上來。
items.wrongTraditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上去。
items.wrongSimplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上去。

right.traditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上來。
right.simplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài èr lóu, qǐng shànglái.
right.english: My room is on the second floor. Please come up.

items.question: Can 起來 take 去 as its partner?
items.answer: 不行。「起來」是固定的說法，表示「up」，沒有「起去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他站起去了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他站起去了。

right.traditional: 他站起來了。
right.simplified: 他站起来了。
right.pinyin: Tā zhàn qǐlái le.
right.english: He stood up.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我朋友在外面等我，我現在要

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！朋友在外面，你要從裡面到外面，用「出去」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「出來」是朝向說話的人；這裡是你出去找朋友。

practice.title: Practice: directional verb + 來 / 去

items.prompt: She is in the room and you are outside the door. What does she want to do?

promptZh.traditional: 她在房間裡，你在門外。她要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 她在房间里，你在门外。她要做什么？

repairs.note: 出去 moves away from the speaker; she is coming out toward you.
進來 means coming in; she is going out of the room.
過去 means going over there; she is coming out here.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 出來: she comes out toward you.

result.traditional: 這個人要出來。
result.simplified: 这个人要出来。
result.pinyin: Zhège rén yào chūlái.
result.english: This person wants to come out.

items.sub: 門開了。

items.prompt: Mom is outside the door and your brother is in front of her. What does she say?

promptZh.traditional: 媽媽在門外，弟弟在媽媽前面。媽媽說什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 妈妈在门外，弟弟在妈妈前面。妈妈说什么？

repairs.note: 過去 is away from Mom; she wants him to come to her.
進來 means coming into a room; they are both outside.
出去 means going out; he is already outside with her.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 過來: she calls him to come to her.

result.traditional: 媽媽說：「過來。」
result.simplified: 妈妈说：「过来。」
result.pinyin: Māma shuō: Guòlái.
result.english: Mom says to come over.

items.prompt: Your friend is waiting outside. What do you need to do?

promptZh.traditional: 朋友在外面等你。你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 朋友在外面等你。你要做什么？

segments.traditional: 我朋友在外面等我，我現在要
segments.simplified: 我朋友在外面等我，我现在要

repairs.note: 出來 is toward the speaker; you are inside and going out to your friend.
上去 means going up, not going out.
進去 means going in; your friend is outside.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 出去: you go out to your friend.

result.traditional: 我朋友在外面等我，我現在要出去。
result.simplified: 我朋友在外面等我，我现在要出去。
result.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zài wàimiàn děng wǒ, wǒ xiànzài yào chūqù.
result.english: My friend is waiting outside; I need to go out now.

items.prompt: Your brother is watching TV upstairs. What does Mom want him to do?

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟在樓上看電視。媽媽要他做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟在楼上看电视。妈妈要他做什么？

segments.traditional: 快吃飯了，弟弟還在樓上看電視，媽媽要他
segments.simplified: 快吃饭了，弟弟还在楼上看电视，妈妈要他

repairs.note: 下去 is away from Mom; she wants him down here.
上來 means coming up; he is already upstairs.
上去 means going up; he needs to come down.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 下來: he is upstairs and comes down to eat.

result.traditional: 快吃飯了，弟弟還在樓上看電視，媽媽要他下來吃飯。
result.simplified: 快吃饭了，弟弟还在楼上看电视，妈妈要他下来吃饭。
result.pinyin: Kuài chīfàn le, dìdi hái zài lóushàng kàn diànshì, māma yào tā xiàlái chīfàn.
result.english: Dinner is almost ready; your brother is still watching TV upstairs, so Mom wants him to come down to eat.

items.sub: 快吃飯了。

items.prompt: Your friend is outside the door. You want him to come into the room.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友在門外。你要他進房間。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友在门外。你要他进房间。

sentence.traditional: 請他進來。
sentence.simplified: 请他进来。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng tā jìnlái.
sentence.english: Ask him to come in.

sentence.traditional: 請進來。
sentence.simplified: 请进来。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng jìnlái.
sentence.english: Please come in.

repairs.note: 進去 is going in away from you; you are inside and want him to come to you.
出去 means going out; he is outside and you want him in.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 請 + him + 進來.

items.prompt: Your brother is playing outside. Mom calls him back home to eat.

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟在外面玩。媽媽叫他回家吃飯。
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟在外面玩。妈妈叫他回家吃饭。

sentence.traditional: 媽媽叫他回來吃飯。
sentence.simplified: 妈妈叫他回来吃饭。
sentence.pinyin: Māma jiào tā huílái chīfàn.
sentence.english: Mom calls him back to eat.

repairs.note: 回去 means going back away from home; Mom wants him back here.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 媽媽 + 叫他 + 回來 + 吃飯.

items.prompt: You are upstairs and your friend is downstairs.

promptZh.traditional: 你在樓上，朋友在樓下。
promptZh.simplified: 你在楼上，朋友在楼下。

repairs.note: 下來 means coming down; your friend is downstairs and must come up.
進去 means going in, not coming up to you.

items.hint: You are upstairs; ask your friend to come up to you.

result.traditional: 我在樓上，請你上來。
result.simplified: 我在楼上，请你上来。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zài lóushàng, qǐng nǐ shànglái.
result.english: I am upstairs; please come up.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 上去 leaves 請你, which does not say where to come.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleTraditional: motion verb + directional verb + 來/去
grammarPages.titleSimplified: motion verb + directional verb + 来/去
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Motion verb + directional verb + 來 / 去
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how someone or something moves: walk out, bring it back, carry it over.
grammarPages.explanation: 動作動詞（走、跑、帶、放、拿、搬、站）後面接方向動詞和「來／去」，說明人或東西往哪個方向移動。方向動詞有「上來/上去、下來/下去、進來/進去、出來/出去、回來/回去、過來/過去」；「拿、搬、站」也可以接「起來」。
grammarPages.pattern: Motion verb + directional verb + 來 / 去

text.traditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面走出來了。
text.simplified: 爸爸从卧室里面走出来了。
text.pinyin: Bàba cóng wòshì lǐmiàn zǒu chūlái le.
text.english: Dad walked out of the bedroom.

text.traditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回去嗎？
text.simplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回去吗？
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē méi chīwán de miànbāo, wǒ kěyǐ dài huíqù ma?
text.english: Can I take these unfinished pieces of bread back with me?

text.traditional: 這部電腦很重，我們一起搬過去吧。
text.simplified: 这部电脑很重，我们一起搬过去吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo hěn zhòng, wǒmen yìqǐ bān guòqù ba.
text.english: This computer is heavy. Let's carry it over together.

items.question: A friend is taking the leftover bread to his own home. Do you say 帶回去 or 帶回來?
items.answer: 東西離開說話的人，用「回去」：帶回去。
items.wrongTraditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回來嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回来吗？

right.traditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回去嗎？
right.simplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回去吗？
right.pinyin: Zhèxiē méi chīwán de miànbāo, wǒ kěyǐ dài huíqù ma?
right.english: Can I take these unfinished pieces of bread back with me?

items.question: Do you say 走出來 or 出來走?
items.answer: 先說動作動詞「走」，再說方向「出來」：走出來。
items.wrongTraditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面出來走。
items.wrongSimplified: 爸爸从卧室里面出来走。

right.traditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面走出來了。
right.simplified: 爸爸从卧室里面走出来了。
right.pinyin: Bàba cóng wòshì lǐmiàn zǒu chūlái le.
right.english: Dad walked out of the bedroom.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！那位先生從便利商店裡面走到外面，用「走出來」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「走進去」是往裡面走；句子說「從便利商店」，表示從裡面出來。

items.prompt: Your brother is on the second floor and wants to go to the first floor. How does he get there?

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟在二樓，要到一樓。他怎麼到一樓？
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟在二楼，要到一楼。他怎么到一楼？

repairs.note: The sentence says he runs fast, not walks.
跑上去 goes up; he starts on the second floor and goes down.
跑出去 means running out, not down the stairs.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 跑下來: he runs down from the second floor.

result.traditional: 孩子從二樓跑下來。
result.simplified: 孩子从二楼跑下来。
result.pinyin: Háizi cóng èr lóu pǎo xiàlái.
result.english: The child runs down from the second floor.

items.sub: 他跑得很快。

items.prompt: The man is inside the convenience store. You are outside waiting for him. How does he get outside?

promptZh.traditional: 先生在便利商店裡面。你在外面等他。他怎麼到外面？
promptZh.simplified: 先生在便利商店里面。你在外面等他。他怎么到外面？

repairs.note: 走進去 goes in; he is inside and comes out to you.
走回來 means coming back; he is simply coming out of the store.
走過去 goes over there; he comes out toward you.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 走出來: he walks out toward you.

result.traditional: 那位先生從便利商店走出來。
result.simplified: 那位先生从便利商店走出来。
result.pinyin: Nà wèi xiānshēng cóng biànlì shāngdiàn zǒu chūlái.
result.english: That man walks out of the convenience store.

items.prompt: What should you do when you talk to your boss?

promptZh.traditional: 跟老闆說話的時候，你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 跟老板说话的时候，你要做什么？

segments.traditional: 跟老闆說話的時候，請你
segments.simplified: 跟老板说话的时候，请你

repairs.note: 坐下來 means sit down, but the sentence says not to sit.
站出去 means stand outside, not stand up.
坐起來 means sit up in bed; you need to stand.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 站起來: stand up.

result.traditional: 跟老闆說話的時候，請你站起來，不要坐著。
result.simplified: 跟老板说话的时候，请你站起来，不要坐着。
result.pinyin: Gēn lǎobǎn shuōhuà de shíhou, qǐng nǐ zhàn qǐlái, búyào zuò zhe.
result.english: When you talk to your boss, please stand up; do not stay seated.

items.prompt: The garbage stinks. What do you ask someone to do?

promptZh.traditional: 垃圾很臭。請你做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 垃圾很臭。请你做什么？

repairs.note: 拿進來 brings it in; smelly garbage goes out.
放下去 means put it down; the garbage must go out.
拿回來 brings it back; you want it out.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 拿出去: take the garbage out.

result.traditional: 這些垃圾很臭，請你拿出去。
result.simplified: 这些垃圾很臭，请你拿出去。
result.pinyin: Zhèxiē lèsè hěn chòu, qǐng nǐ ná chūqù.
result.english: This garbage stinks; please take it out.

items.prompt: It is raining. He runs in from outside.

promptZh.traditional: 外面下雨了。他從外面跑進房子裡。
promptZh.simplified: 外面下雨了。他从外面跑进房子里。

sentence.traditional: 他從外面跑進來。
sentence.simplified: 他从外面跑进来。
sentence.pinyin: Tā cóng wàimiàn pǎo jìnlái.
sentence.english: He runs in from outside.

repairs.note: 跑出去 means running out; the rain makes him run in.
Use 跑進來: the verb 跑 comes before 進來.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 他 + 從 + 外面 + 跑進來.

items.prompt: The sofa is heavy. We need to carry it upstairs.

promptZh.traditional: 沙發很重。我們要搬到樓上。
promptZh.simplified: 沙发很重。我们要搬到楼上。

sentence.traditional: 沙發很重，我們一起搬上去。
sentence.simplified: 沙发很重，我们一起搬上去。
sentence.pinyin: Shāfā hěn zhòng, wǒmen yìqǐ bān shàngqù.
sentence.english: The sofa is heavy; let us carry it up together.

sentence.traditional: 沙發很重，我們搬上去。
sentence.simplified: 沙发很重，我们搬上去。
sentence.pinyin: Shāfā hěn zhòng, wǒmen bān shàngqù.
sentence.english: The sofa is heavy; we'll carry it up.

repairs.note: 搬下來 means carry it down; you are taking it up.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沙發很重 + 我們 + 搬上去; 一起 is optional.

items.prompt: When the teacher comes into the classroom, everyone is not sitting.

promptZh.traditional: 老師進教室的時候，大家都不坐著。
promptZh.simplified: 老师进教室的时候，大家都不坐着。

repairs.note: 坐下來 means sit down; everyone is not sitting, so they stand.
站出去 means stand outside; they are in the classroom.

items.hint: When the teacher comes in, everyone stands up.

result.traditional: 老師進教室的時候，我們都站起來。
result.simplified: 老师进教室的时候，我们都站起来。
result.pinyin: Lǎoshī jìn jiàoshì de shíhou, wǒmen dōu zhàn qǐlái.
result.english: When the teacher comes into the classroom, we all stand up.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 站上來 leaves 我們都, which does not say what everyone did.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleTraditional: motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去
grammarPages.titleSimplified: motion verb + directional verb + location + 来/去
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Motion verb + directional verb + place + 來 / 去
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a place to a movement: put it into the closet, take the books back to Japan.
grammarPages.explanation: 動作動詞和方向動詞後面可以再帶地方，最後用「來／去」表示方向：放進衣櫃裡去、帶回日本去。
grammarPages.pattern: Motion verb + directional verb + location + 來 / 去

text.traditional: 那些髒衣服不要放進衣櫃裡去。
text.simplified: 那些脏衣服不要放进衣柜里去。
text.pinyin: Nàxiē zāng yīfu búyào fàng jìn yīguì lǐ qù.
text.english: Don't put those dirty clothes into the closet.

text.traditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回日本去。
text.simplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回日本去。
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén shū, Shānběn Liángjiè dōu yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
text.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto will take all these Chinese books back to Japan.

text.traditional: 路上的車很多，那個人從對面跑過街來，真危險！
text.simplified: 路上的车很多，那个人从对面跑过街来，真危险！
text.pinyin: Lùshang de chē hěn duō, nàge rén cóng duìmiàn pǎo guò jiē lái, zhēn wéixiǎn!
text.english: There are many cars on the road. That person ran across the street from the opposite side. How dangerous!

items.question: Where does the place go in 放進衣櫃裡去?
items.answer: 地方放在方向動詞後面：「放進衣櫃裡去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 那些髒衣服不要放衣櫃裡進去。
items.wrongSimplified: 那些脏衣服不要放衣柜里进去。

right.traditional: 那些髒衣服不要放進衣櫃裡去。
right.simplified: 那些脏衣服不要放进衣柜里去。
right.pinyin: Nàxiē zāng yīfu búyào fàng jìn yīguì lǐ qù.
right.english: Don't put those dirty clothes into the closet.

items.question: Is it 帶回日本去 or 帶回去日本?
items.answer: 地方放在「來／去」前面：「帶回日本去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回去日本。
items.wrongSimplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回去日本。

right.traditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回日本去。
right.simplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回日本去。
right.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén shū, Shānběn Liángjiè dōu yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
right.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto will take all these Chinese books back to Japan.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我的錢包放在客廳，請你幫我

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！錢包在客廳裡面，請人從裡面拿到外面，用「拿出來」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「拿進去」是拿到裡面；錢包已經在客廳裡了。

practice.title: Practice: motion verb + directional verb + place

items.prompt: You are at the fruit shop and want to take the fruit home. What do you say?

promptZh.traditional: 你在水果店，想帶水果回家。你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 你在水果店，想带水果回家。你要做什么？

repairs.note: 帶回來 brings them toward the shop; you are taking them home, away from here.
拿出來 means take them out; you are taking them home.
帶過去 means take them over there; you are taking them back home.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 帶回去: take the fruit back home.

result.traditional: 這些水果，我要帶回去。
result.simplified: 这些水果，我要带回去。
result.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, wǒ yào dài huíqù.
result.english: These fruits—I want to take them back.

items.sub: 你在水果店。

items.prompt: You are upstairs and the sofa is downstairs. What do you want to do?

promptZh.traditional: 你在樓上，沙發在樓下。你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 你在楼上，沙发在楼下。你要做什么？

repairs.note: 搬下去 means carry it down; you are upstairs and want it here.
搬過來 means carry it over; it is downstairs and must come up.
搬上去 means carry it up away from you; you are already upstairs.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 搬上來: move the sofa up to you.

result.traditional: 樓下的那張沙發，我要搬上來。
result.simplified: 楼下的那张沙发，我要搬上来。
result.pinyin: Lóuxià de nà zhāng shāfā, wǒ yào bān shànglái.
result.english: That sofa downstairs—I want to move it up here.

items.prompt: Your wallet is in the living room. What do you ask your friend to do?

promptZh.traditional: 錢包在客廳。請朋友幫你做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 钱包在客厅。请朋友帮你做什么？

segments.traditional: 我的錢包放在客廳，請你幫我
segments.simplified: 我的钱包放在客厅，请你帮我

repairs.note: 拿進去 takes it further in; the wallet is inside and you want it out.
拿回來 means bring it back; it is in the living room, not away.
拿過去 takes it over there; you want it here.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 拿出來: take the wallet out to me.

result.traditional: 我的錢包放在客廳，請你幫我拿出來。
result.simplified: 我的钱包放在客厅，请你帮我拿出来。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo fàng zài kètīng, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ ná chūlái.
result.english: My wallet is in the living room; please get it out for me.

items.prompt: These books are yours. You want to take the books back to Japan. Say it with 去.

promptZh.traditional: 這些書是你的。你要帶書回日本。用「去」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这些书是你的。你要带书回日本。用「去」说。

sentence.traditional: 這些書，我要帶回日本去。
sentence.simplified: 这些书，我要带回日本去。
sentence.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū, wǒ yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
sentence.english: These books—I want to take them back to Japan.

repairs.note: 帶去 has no place; say 帶回 + 日本 + 去.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 帶回 + 日本 + 去: the place goes before 去.

items.prompt: This glass of water; please take it to the kitchen. Say it with 去.

promptZh.traditional: 這杯水，請你拿到廚房。用「去」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这杯水，请你拿到厨房。用「去」说。

sentence.traditional: 這杯水，請你拿到廚房去。
sentence.simplified: 这杯水，请你拿到厨房去。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè bēi shuǐ, qǐng nǐ ná dào chúfáng qù.
sentence.english: This glass of water—please take it to the kitchen.

repairs.note: 拿來 cannot take a place after it; use 拿到 + place + 去.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 拿到 + 廚房 + 去.

items.prompt: The puppy is outside and you are in the room. The puppy runs into your room. Say it with 來.

promptZh.traditional: 小狗在外面，你在房間裡。小狗跑進你的房間。用「來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 小狗在外面，你在房间里。小狗跑进你的房间。用「来」说。

sentence.traditional: 小狗從外面跑進房間裡來。
sentence.simplified: 小狗从外面跑进房间里来。
sentence.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu cóng wàimiàn pǎo jìn fángjiān lǐ lái.
sentence.english: The puppy runs in from outside into the room.

repairs.note: 去 is away from you; the puppy comes into your room, so use 來.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 小狗 + 從外面 + 跑進 + 房間裡 + 來.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with directional verbs
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 to move something to a place: bring the desk over, take the clothes upstairs.
grammarPages.explanation: 用「把」把要移動的東西放在前面，後面接動作動詞、方向動詞和「來／去」，也可以加上地方：把書桌搬過來、把衣服拿上樓去。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來 / 去

columns.meaning: take out of the washing machine

text.traditional: 請你把那張書桌搬過來。
text.simplified: 请你把那张书桌搬过来。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ nà zhāng shūzhuō bān guòlái.
text.english: Please move that desk over here.

text.traditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓去了。
text.simplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼去了。
text.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ tā de yīfu ná shànglóu qù le.
text.english: My older sister took her clothes upstairs.

text.traditional: 我還沒把褲子從洗衣機裡拿出來。
text.simplified: 我还没把裤子从洗衣机里拿出来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi bǎ kùzi cóng xǐyījī lǐ ná chūlái.
text.english: I haven't taken the pants out of the washing machine yet.

items.question: What happens if you leave out the directional ending after 搬?
items.answer: 「把」字句的動詞後面要有結果或方向：搬過來。
items.wrongTraditional: 請你把那張書桌搬。
items.wrongSimplified: 请你把那张书桌搬。

right.traditional: 請你把那張書桌搬過來。
right.simplified: 请你把那张书桌搬过来。
right.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ nà zhāng shūzhuō bān guòlái.
right.english: Please move that desk over here.

items.question: Where does 了 go in 拿上樓去?
items.answer: 「了」放在最後，表示動作完成：拿上樓去了。
items.wrongTraditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓了去。
items.wrongSimplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼了去。

right.traditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓去了。
right.simplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼去了。
right.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ tā de yīfu ná shànglóu qù le.
right.english: My older sister took her clothes upstairs.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！孩子處理垃圾，用「把」把垃圾放在動詞前面。
questions.repairFeedback: 「被」表示被動；這裡是孩子主動丟垃圾。

items.prompt: Put the sentence in order.

promptZh.traditional: 把句子排好。
promptZh.simplified: 把句子排好。

sentence.traditional: 我昨天沒把書帶回家去。
sentence.simplified: 我昨天没把书带回家去。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān méi bǎ shū dài huí jiā qù.
sentence.english: I did not take the book home yesterday.

repairs.note: 已經 would say you did take it home; the sentence says you did not.
Put 沒 before 把: the negation comes first.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 我昨天 first, then 沒 + 把 + 書 + 帶回家去.
items.sub: 你昨天的書還在學校。

items.prompt: Put the sentence in order.

promptZh.traditional: 把句子排好。
promptZh.simplified: 把句子排好。

sentence.traditional: 孩子把垃圾丟進袋子裡去。
sentence.simplified: 孩子把垃圾丢进袋子里去。
sentence.pinyin: Háizi bǎ lèsè diū jìn dàizi lǐ qù.
sentence.english: The child throws the garbage into the bag.

repairs.note: 進來 means come in; the sentence says throw the garbage into the bag.
Put 把 before 垃圾: 把 marks the thing being moved.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 孩子 + 把 + 垃圾 + 丟進 + 袋子裡去.
items.sub: 孩子丟垃圾。垃圾在袋子裡。

items.prompt: Put the sentence in order.

promptZh.traditional: 把句子排好。
promptZh.simplified: 把句子排好。

sentence.traditional: 請你把杯子拿起來，我要擦桌子。
sentence.simplified: 请你把杯子拿起来，我要擦桌子。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ bēizi ná qǐlái, wǒ yào cā zhuōzi.
sentence.english: Please pick up the cup; I want to wipe the table.

sentence.traditional: 我要擦桌子，請你把杯子拿起來。
sentence.simplified: 我要擦桌子，请你把杯子拿起来。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yào cā zhuōzi, qǐng nǐ bǎ bēizi ná qǐlái.
sentence.english: I want to wipe the table; please pick up the cup.

repairs.note: 放下來 means put it down; you need the cup picked up so you can wipe the table.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 請你 + 把杯子 + 拿起來, then 我要 + 擦桌子.
items.sub: 杯子在桌子上。你要擦桌子。

items.prompt: The desk is at the door and you want it beside you.

promptZh.traditional: 書桌在門口，你要書桌在你旁邊。
promptZh.simplified: 书桌在门口，你要书桌在你旁边。

repairs.note: 搬上去 means carry it up, not over to you.
搬出去 means carry it out; you want it here.

items.hint: The desk should come over to you; the verb needs a direction after it.

result.traditional: 請你把書桌搬過來。
result.simplified: 请你把书桌搬过来。
result.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ shūzhuō bān guòlái.
result.english: Please move the desk over here.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 搬 leaves 請你把書桌, which has no verb.

items.prompt: The fruit was downstairs; now it is upstairs. Say it with 把.

promptZh.traditional: 水果在樓下，現在在樓上了。用「把」說。
promptZh.simplified: 水果在楼下，现在在楼上了。用「把」说。

sentence.traditional: 姐姐把水果拿上樓去了。
sentence.simplified: 姐姐把水果拿上楼去了。
sentence.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ shuǐguǒ ná shànglóu qù le.
sentence.english: My sister took the fruit upstairs.

repairs.note: 拿下來 means bring it down; she takes it up.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 姐姐 + 把 + 水果 + 拿上樓 + 去了.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a doubled two-syllable verb to say you will do something briefly and casually.
grammarPages.explanation: 兩個音節的動詞可以重疊成 XYXY，語氣比較輕鬆，表示動作時間不長。這個說法不能和「一下」、「一點」一起用。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + XYXY (+ Object)

text.traditional: 他們都是我的同學，我給你介紹介紹。
text.simplified: 他们都是我的同学，我给你介绍介绍。
text.pinyin: Tāmen dōu shì wǒ de tóngxué, wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào jièshào.
text.english: They are all my classmates. Let me introduce them to you.

text.traditional: 我還沒決定要不要去留學，我要和父母討論討論。
text.simplified: 我还没决定要不要去留学，我要和父母讨论讨论。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi juédìng yào bu yào qù liúxué, wǒ yào hé fùmǔ tǎolùn tǎolùn.
text.english: I haven't decided whether to study abroad yet. I want to discuss it with my parents.

text.traditional: 弟弟的房間有一點兒髒，這個週末他要打掃打掃。
text.simplified: 弟弟的房间有一点儿脏，这个周末他要打扫打扫。
text.pinyin: Dìdi de fángjiān yǒu yìdiǎnr zāng, zhège zhōumò tā yào dǎsǎo dǎsǎo.
text.english: My younger brother's room is a little dirty. He will do some cleaning this weekend.

items.question: Can you add 一下 to 討論討論?
items.answer: 不行。XYXY 已經表示動作不久，不能再加「一下」或「一點」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我要和父母討論討論一下。
items.wrongSimplified: 我要和父母讨论讨论一下。

right.traditional: 我要和父母討論討論。
right.simplified: 我要和父母讨论讨论。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yào hé fùmǔ tǎolùn tǎolùn.
right.english: I want to discuss it with my parents.

items.question: Is 打掃一打掃 correct for a two-syllable verb?
items.answer: 不行。兩個音節的動詞重疊成 XYXY：打掃打掃。
items.wrongTraditional: 這個週末他要打掃一打掃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个周末他要打扫一打扫。

right.traditional: 這個週末他要打掃打掃。
right.simplified: 这个周末他要打扫打扫。
right.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò tā yào dǎsǎo dǎsǎo.
right.english: This weekend he will do some cleaning.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 外國學生希望有機會可以

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！兩個音節的動詞重疊成 XYXY，用「認識認識」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「認識一下」不是這個句型；這裡要重疊整個動詞。

items.prompt: The foreign student wants to get to know Taiwanese friends. Say 認識 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 外國學生想認識台灣朋友。用「認識」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 外国学生想认识台湾朋友。用「认识」说两次。

segments.traditional: 外國學生希望有機會可以
segments.simplified: 外国学生希望有机会可以

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.
Use the doubled form 認識認識.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 認識認識: double the two-syllable verb.

result.traditional: 外國學生希望有機會可以認識認識台灣朋友。
result.simplified: 外国学生希望有机会可以认识认识台湾朋友。
result.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng xīwàng yǒu jīhuì kěyǐ rènshì rènshì Táiwān péngyǒu.
result.english: The foreign student hopes to have a chance to get to know Taiwanese friends.

items.prompt: You finished the housework and feel tired. Say 休息 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 你做完家事，覺得很累。用「休息」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 你做完家事，觉得很累。用「休息」说两次。

segments.traditional: 我一個人把家事都做完了，覺得有點兒累，要
segments.simplified: 我一个人把家事都做完了，觉得有点儿累，要

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.
You are tired, so you rest, not practice.
There is nothing to celebrate; you are tired.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 休息休息: double the verb for a short rest.

result.traditional: 我一個人把家事都做完了，覺得有點兒累，要休息休息。
result.simplified: 我一个人把家事都做完了，觉得有点儿累，要休息休息。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge rén bǎ jiāshì dōu zuò wán le, juéde yǒu diǎnr lèi, yào xiūxí xiūxí.
result.english: I finished all the housework alone and feel a little tired, so I want to rest a bit.

items.sub: 家事都做完了。

items.prompt: Tomorrow is Mom's birthday. Say 慶祝 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日。用「慶祝」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 明天是妈妈的生日。用「庆祝」说两次。

segments.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日，我們要買蛋糕給她
segments.simplified: 明天是妈妈的生日，我们要买蛋糕给她

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.
A birthday is celebrated; 歡迎 means welcome.
A birthday is celebrated, not welcomed.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 慶祝慶祝: double the verb.

result.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日，我們要買蛋糕給她慶祝慶祝。
result.simplified: 明天是妈妈的生日，我们要买蛋糕给她庆祝庆祝。
result.pinyin: Míngtiān shì māma de shēngrì, wǒmen yào mǎi dàngāo gěi tā qìngzhù qìngzhù.
result.english: Tomorrow is Mom's birthday; we will buy a cake to celebrate a little.

items.prompt: This matter is important; you want to discuss it with a friend. Say 討論 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 這件事很重要。你要跟朋友討論。用「討論」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 这件事很重要。你要跟朋友讨论。用「讨论」说两次。

sentence.traditional: 這件事很重要，我要跟朋友討論討論。
sentence.simplified: 这件事很重要，我要跟朋友讨论讨论。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu tǎolùn tǎolùn.
sentence.english: This matter is important; I want to discuss it with a friend.

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 這件事 + 很重要 + 我要 + 跟朋友 + 討論討論.

items.prompt: You want to discuss this problem with a friend.

promptZh.traditional: 你要跟朋友討論這個問題。
promptZh.simplified: 你要跟朋友讨论这个问题。

repairs.note: 討論 alone does not fix the extra word; take it out.
討論一下 is a different short form; here you already have 討論討論.
討論討論 is already in the sentence; do not add it again.

items.hint: XYXY already means a short, casual action; it cannot take a phrase that adds the same meaning.

result.traditional: 我們要討論討論這個問題。
result.simplified: 我们要讨论讨论这个问题。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen yào tǎolùn tǎolùn zhège wèntí.
result.english: We need to discuss this matter a bit.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Judgemental 起來: how something seems
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use V起來 to say how something looks, sounds or feels.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V起來」用來說對人或事物的感覺或看法。前面的動詞常是「看、聽、吃、喝、穿」等單音節動詞，後面接評論。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + V起來 (+ Adv) + Adjective

text.traditional: A：王小姐看起來很害羞。B：是啊！她不敢跟不熟的男生說話。
text.simplified: A：王小姐看起来很害羞。B：是啊！她不敢跟不熟的男生说话。
text.pinyin: A: Wáng xiǎojiě kànqǐlái hěn hàixiū. B: Shì a! Tā bù gǎn gēn bù shóu de nánshēng shuōhuà.
text.english: A: Miss Wang looks shy. B: Yes! She doesn't dare talk to boys she doesn't know well.

text.traditional: A：明天放假，我們去動物園吧。B：聽起來不錯，我們幾點去呢？
text.simplified: A：明天放假，我们去动物园吧。B：听起来不错，我们几点去呢？
text.pinyin: A: Míngtiān fàngjià, wǒmen qù dòngwùyuán ba. B: Tīngqǐlái búcuò, wǒmen jǐ diǎn qù ne?
text.english: A: We're off tomorrow. Let's go to the zoo. B: That sounds good. What time shall we go?

text.traditional: A：這件裙子是今年最流行的。B：看起來不錯，你穿起來應該很好看。
text.simplified: A：这件裙子是今年最流行的。B：看起来不错，你穿起来应该很好看。
text.pinyin: A: Zhè jiàn qúnzi shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de. B: Kànqǐlái búcuò, nǐ chuān qǐlái yīnggāi hěn hǎokàn.
text.english: A: This skirt is the most popular style this year. B: It looks nice. It should look good on you.

items.question: Do you say 看起來不錯 or 不錯看起來?
items.answer: 「起來」放在動詞後面，評論放在最後：看起來不錯。
items.wrongTraditional: 這件裙子不錯看起來。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件裙子不错看起来。

right.traditional: 這件裙子看起來不錯。
right.simplified: 这件裙子看起来不错。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn qúnzi kànqǐlái búcuò.
right.english: This skirt looks nice.

items.question: Is it 穿起來 or 穿出來 for how clothes look on you?
items.answer: 說衣服穿在身上的樣子，用「穿起來」：穿起來很好看。
items.wrongTraditional: 你穿出來應該很好看。
items.wrongSimplified: 你穿出来应该很好看。

right.traditional: 你穿起來應該很好看。
right.simplified: 你穿起来应该很好看。
right.pinyin: Nǐ chuān qǐlái yīnggāi hěn hǎokàn.
right.english: It should look good on you.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「看起來」後面接評論「很好喝」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「起來」要放在「看」後面，評論放在最後。

items.prompt: The older brother says the soup looks good; the younger brother takes a sip and finds it too sweet. Answer with 喝.

promptZh.traditional: 哥哥說雞湯看起來很好喝。弟弟喝了，覺得太甜。用「喝」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 哥哥说鸡汤看起来很好喝。弟弟喝了，觉得太甜。用「喝」回答。

segments.traditional: 媽媽今天做的雞湯看起來很好喝。
segments.simplified: 妈妈今天做的鸡汤看起来很好喝。

repairs.note: 看起來 is about how it looks; he tasted it.
The first speaker already said it looks good; the brother says it is too sweet.
Use the V起來 pattern: 喝起來.
太甜了 is the comment; it comes after 喝起來.
喝起來 comes before the comment, not after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 喝起來 before the comment 太甜了.

result.traditional: 可是喝起來太甜了。
result.simplified: 可是喝起来太甜了。
result.pinyin: Kěshì hē qǐlái tài tián le.
result.english: But it tastes too sweet.

items.prompt: The MRT station is a 20-minute walk away. Answer with 聽.

promptZh.traditional: 捷運站走路要二十分鐘。用「聽」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 捷运站走路要二十分钟。用「听」回答。

segments.traditional: 離這裡最近的捷運站，走路要二十分鐘。
segments.simplified: 离这里最近的捷运站，走路要二十分钟。

repairs.note: You are hearing about the walk, not seeing it.
Twenty minutes is far, not near.
Use the V起來 pattern: 聽起來.
很遠 is the comment; it comes after 聽起來.
聽起來 comes before the comment.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 聽起來 before the comment 很遠.

result.traditional: 聽起來很遠。
result.simplified: 听起来很远。
result.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yuǎn.
result.english: It sounds far.

items.prompt: The house is nice and the transportation is convenient, but they have four children. Answer with 住.

promptZh.traditional: 這個房子不錯，交通很方便，可是他們有四個孩子。用「住」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 这个房子不错，交通很方便，可是他们有四个孩子。用「住」回答。

segments.traditional: 我覺得這個房子不錯，交通也很方便。
segments.simplified: 我觉得这个房子不错，交通也很方便。

repairs.note: The comment is about living there, not looks.
Four children need more space, so it is too small, not too big.
Use the V起來 pattern: 住起來.
太小了 is the comment; it comes after 住起來.
住起來 comes before the comment.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 住起來 before the comment 太小了.

result.traditional: 可是我們有四個孩子，住起來太小了。
result.simplified: 可是我们有四个孩子，住起来太小了。
result.pinyin: Kěshì wǒmen yǒu sì ge háizi, zhù qǐlái tài xiǎo le.
result.english: But we have four children; it is too small to live in.

items.prompt: The food at this restaurant tastes good. Say it with 起來.

promptZh.traditional: 這家餐廳的菜很好吃。用「起來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃。用「起来」说。

sentence.traditional: 這家餐廳的菜吃起來很不錯。
sentence.simplified: 这家餐厅的菜吃起来很不错。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài chī qǐlái hěn búcuò.
sentence.english: The food at this restaurant tastes pretty good.

repairs.note: You are talking about taste, not looks.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 這家 + 餐廳 + 的菜 + 吃起來 + 很不錯.

items.prompt: You wear these shoes and feel comfortable. Say it with 起來.

promptZh.traditional: 你穿這雙鞋子，覺得很舒服。用「起來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你穿这双鞋子，觉得很舒服。用「起来」说。

sentence.traditional: 這雙鞋子穿起來很舒服。
sentence.simplified: 这双鞋子穿起来很舒服。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xiézi chuān qǐlái hěn shūfu.
sentence.english: These shoes feel comfortable to wear.

repairs.note: You are talking about how they feel, not how they look.
Use the V起來 pattern: 穿起來.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 這雙鞋子 + 穿起來 + 很舒服.

items.prompt: Place 看起來 where it belongs.

promptZh.traditional: 把「看起來」放好。
promptZh.simplified: 把「看起来」放好。

repairs.note: 看起來 comes before the comment 很不錯, not after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 看起來 before 很不錯.

result.traditional: 這家餐廳看起來很不錯。
result.simplified: 这家餐厅看起来很不错。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng kànqǐlái hěn búcuò.
result.english: This restaurant looks pretty good.

items.sub: 你看到一家餐廳，覺得不錯。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 替: for or on behalf of someone
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that you do something for someone else with 替.
grammarPages.explanation: 「替」表示代替別人做事。句型是「替＋人＋動詞」：替我裝網路、替他上課。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 替 + Person + Verb Phrase

text.traditional: 你可以替我裝網路嗎？費用我自己付。
text.simplified: 你可以替我装网路吗？费用我自己付。
text.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ tì wǒ zhuāng wǎnglù ma? Fèiyòng wǒ zìjǐ fù.
text.english: Can you set up the internet for me? I'll pay the fee myself.

text.traditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他上課。
text.simplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他上课。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān Wáng lǎoshī bù shūfu, suǒyǐ Lín lǎoshī tì tā shàngkè.
text.english: Teacher Wang didn't feel well yesterday, so Teacher Lin taught the class for him.

text.traditional: 孩子應該自己打掃房間，父母不要常常替他們做。
text.simplified: 孩子应该自己打扫房间，父母不要常常替他们做。
text.pinyin: Háizi yīnggāi zìjǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān, fùmǔ búyào chángcháng tì tāmen zuò.
text.english: Children should clean their rooms themselves. Parents should not often do it for them.

items.question: Does 替 come before the person or after the verb?
items.answer: 「替」放在人前面，動詞在最後：替我裝網路。
items.wrongTraditional: 我裝網路替你。
items.wrongSimplified: 我装网路替你。

right.traditional: 我替你裝網路。
right.simplified: 我替你装网路。
right.pinyin: Wǒ tì nǐ zhuāng wǎnglù.
right.english: I'll set up the internet for you.

items.question: Can 替他 stand alone without a verb?
items.answer: 不行。「替」後面要說出做的事：替他上課。
items.wrongTraditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他。
items.wrongSimplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他。

right.traditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他上課。
right.simplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他上课。
right.pinyin: Zuótiān Wáng lǎoshī bù shūfu, suǒyǐ Lín lǎoshī tì tā shàngkè.
right.english: Teacher Wang didn't feel well yesterday, so Teacher Lin taught the class for him.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我沒做過你的工作，沒辦法

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！代替別人去上班，用「替你上班」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「替」後面先說人，再說做的事：替你上班。

items.prompt: Your friend forgot his wallet. What do you say?

promptZh.traditional: 朋友忘了帶錢包。你說什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 朋友忘了带钱包。你说什么？

items.sub: A：我忘了帶錢包，怎麼辦？

sentence.traditional: 沒關係，我替你付。
sentence.simplified: 没关系，我替你付。
sentence.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒ tì nǐ fù.
sentence.english: It is all right; I will pay for you.

sentence.traditional: 我替你付。
sentence.simplified: 我替你付。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ tì nǐ fù.
sentence.english: I will pay for you.

repairs.note: 替 comes before the person, then the verb: 替你付.
幫 needs the person after it; here the person 你 is already inside 替你.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沒關係 + 我 + 替你 + 付.

items.prompt: Your friend cannot go to work tomorrow. What do you say?

promptZh.traditional: 朋友明天不能去上班。你怎麼說？
promptZh.simplified: 朋友明天不能去上班。你怎么说？

segments.traditional: 明天我有事不能去上班，你可以幫我嗎？
segments.simplified: 明天我有事不能去上班，你可以帮我吗？

segments.traditional: 我沒做過你的工作，沒辦法
segments.simplified: 我没做过你的工作，没办法

repairs.note: He is asking about work, not class.
替 comes before the person, then the verb: 替你上班.
上班 is the verb phrase; it comes after 替你.
替你 comes before the verb phrase.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沒辦法 + 替你 + 上班.

result.traditional: 我沒做過你的工作，沒辦法替你上班。
result.simplified: 我没做过你的工作，没办法替你上班。
result.pinyin: Wǒ méi zuò guo nǐ de gōngzuò, méi bànfǎ tì nǐ shàngbān.
result.english: I have never done your job; I cannot go to work for you.

items.prompt: Your younger brother doesn't want to do his homework and asks you to do it. What do you say?

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟不想寫作業，請你寫他的作業。哥哥說什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟不想写作业，请你写他的作业。哥哥说什么？

segments.traditional: 我不知道怎麼寫這個作業，你可以替我寫嗎？
segments.simplified: 我不知道怎么写这个作业，你可以替我写吗？

repairs.note: 替 comes before the person, then the verb: 替你寫作業.
作業寫 reverses the verb and object; say 寫作業.
寫作業 is the verb phrase; it comes after 替你.
替你 comes before the verb phrase.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 知道我 + 替你 + 寫作業.

result.traditional: 如果媽媽知道我替你寫作業，她會打我們！
result.simplified: 如果妈妈知道我替你写作业，她会打我们！
result.pinyin: Rúguǒ māma zhīdào wǒ tì nǐ xiě zuòyè, tā huì dǎ wǒmen!
result.english: If Mom knows I did your homework for you, she will hit us!

items.prompt: You want your friend to get you a glass of water. Say it with 替.

promptZh.traditional: 你要朋友幫你拿一杯水。用「替」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你要朋友帮你拿一杯水。用「替」说。

sentence.traditional: 請你替我拿一杯水。
sentence.simplified: 请你替我拿一杯水。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ tì wǒ ná yì bēi shuǐ.
sentence.english: Please get me a glass of water.

repairs.note: The person doing the favor is 你, so say 替你.
Use 一杯水: the measure phrase comes with 水.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 請你 + 替我 + 拿 + 一杯水.

items.prompt: Your sister is busy. Say with 替 that you clean her room for her.

promptZh.traditional: 姐姐很忙。用「替」說你幫她打掃房間。
promptZh.simplified: 姐姐很忙。用「替」说你帮她打扫房间。

sentence.traditional: 姐姐很忙，我替她打掃房間。
sentence.simplified: 姐姐很忙，我替她打扫房间。
sentence.pinyin: Jiějie hěn máng, wǒ tì tā dǎsǎo fángjiān.
sentence.english: My sister is busy, so I clean her room for her.

repairs.note: 打掃 needs its object 房間: 打掃房間.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 姐姐 + 很忙 + 我 + 替她 + 打掃房間.

items.prompt: Your friend doesn't know how to set up the internet, so you do it.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友不會裝網路，你來裝。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友不会装网路，你来装。

repairs.note: 幫 also needs the person right after it: 幫你; here 你 is after the verb.
給 does not mean doing something for someone here.

items.hint: The person you do the favor for comes right after the word that means for.

result.traditional: 我替你裝網路。
result.simplified: 我替你装网路。
result.pinyin: Wǒ tì nǐ zhuāng wǎnglù.
result.english: I will set up the internet for you.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 替 leaves 我裝網路, which does not say who the internet is for.

items.title: Grammar 8–9 · Renting a House Is Not Easy

dialogue.title: 短文 · 租房子不容易

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 山本良介來台灣以後，一直住在學校的宿舍，可是他下個學期不想住了，因為室友很晚才睡覺，總是在半夜開著燈打電腦，聲音很吵。除了生活習慣很不一樣，良介的室友還常常把房間弄得很髒，所以他決定到學校外面去租房子。
lines.simplified: 山本良介来台湾以后，一直住在学校的宿舍，可是他下个学期不想住了，因为室友很晚才睡觉，总是在半夜开着灯打电脑，声音很吵。除了生活习惯很不一样，良介的室友还常常把房间弄得很脏，所以他决定到学校外面去租房子。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, yìzhí zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè, kěshì tā xià ge xuéqī bù xiǎng zhù le, yīnwèi shìyǒu hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào, zǒngshì zài bànyè kāizhe dēng dǎ diànnǎo, shēngyīn hěn chǎo. Chúle shēnghuó xíguàn hěn bù yíyàng, Liángjiè de shìyǒu hái chángcháng bǎ fángjiān nòng de hěn zāng, suǒyǐ tā juédìng dào xuéxiào wàimiàn qù zū fángzi.
lines.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he has always been living in the school dormitory, but he doesn't want to live there next semester. That was because his roommate slept late, always used the computer with the light on at midnight, and made a lot of noise. In addition to different living habits, Ryosuke's roommate often made their room dirty, so he decided to rent a house off-campus.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介本來覺得找房子不難，沒想到不太順利。他上租屋網站找了很多資料，可是看了好幾個地方都不滿意。有的房東一看他是外國人，就不太願意租給他。陳可欣知道他的問題以後，就決定陪他去找房子、看房子。
lines.simplified: 良介本来觉得找房子不难，没想到不太顺利。他上租屋网站找了很多资料，可是看了好几个地方都不满意。有的房东一看他是外国人，就不太愿意租给他。陈可欣知道他的问题以后，就决定陪他去找房子、看房子。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè běnlái juéde zhǎo fángzi bù nán, méi xiǎngdào bú tài shùnlì. Tā shàng zūwū wǎngzhàn zhǎo le hěn duō zīliào, kěshì kàn le hǎo jǐ ge dìfāng dōu bù mǎnyì. Yǒude fángdōng yí kàn tā shì wàiguórén, jiù bú tài yuànyì zū gěi tā. Chén Kěxīn zhīdào tā de wèntí yǐhòu, jiù juédìng péi tā qù zhǎo fángzi, kàn fángzi.
lines.english: Ryosuke supposed that finding a house was not difficult. He never thought that it would not go smoothly. He searched for a lot of information on house rental websites. However, after he viewed several places, he still was not satisfied. Some landlords were unwilling to rent out their houses to him just because he was a foreigner. After knowing his problem, Chen Kexin decided to accompany him to find and view houses.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 良介聽說王太太的公寓要出租，就找可欣一起去看看。那個公寓附近的環境不錯，離學校也不太遠。雖然良介很想租，但是付了房租以後，獎學金就只剩下一萬塊錢了。他問王太太，房租可不可以便宜一點兒。因為王太太的兒子在法國留學，她知道一個人在國外生活不容易。她想了想，決定只收良介一萬兩千元的房租，良介很高興可以搬家了。
lines.simplified: 良介听说王太太的公寓要出租，就找可欣一起去看看。那个公寓附近的环境不错，离学校也不太远。虽然良介很想租，但是付了房租以后，奖学金就只剩下一万块钱了。他问王太太，房租可不可以便宜一点儿。因为王太太的儿子在法国留学，她知道一个人在国外生活不容易。她想了想，决定只收良介一万两千元的房租，良介很高兴可以搬家了。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè tīngshuō Wáng tàitai de gōngyù yào chūzū, jiù zhǎo Kěxīn yìqǐ qù kànkan. Nàge gōngyù fùjìn de huánjìng búcuò, lí xuéxiào yě bú tài yuǎn. Suīrán Liángjiè hěn xiǎng zū, dànshì fù le fángzū yǐhòu, jiǎngxuéjīn jiù zhǐ shèngxià yí wàn kuài qián le. Tā wèn Wáng tàitai, fángzū kě bu kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎnr. Yīnwèi Wáng tàitai de érzi zài Fǎguó liúxué, tā zhīdào yí ge rén zài guówài shēnghuó bù róngyì. Tā xiǎng le xiǎng, juédìng zhǐ shōu Liángjiè yí wàn liǎngqiān yuán de fángzū, Liángjiè hěn gāoxìng kěyǐ bānjiā le.
lines.english: As soon as Ryosuke heard Mrs. Wang's apartment was for rent, he went with Kexin to have a look. The surroundings of the apartment were not bad and it was not too far away from the school. Although Ryosuke would like to rent it, he would have only $10,000 of his scholarship left after paying the rent. He asked Mrs. Wang whether the rent could be cheaper. Because Mrs. Wang's son has been studying in France, she knew that it was not easy to live abroad alone. After thinking it over, she decided to charge Ryosuke a rent of only $12,000. Ryosuke was happy that he could move.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 除了……還…… to add a second, more important point.
grammarPages.explanation: 「除了……還……」先說一個情況，再加上另一個更重要的情況。「除了」後面可以接名詞、動詞或短句；前後主語不同時，第二個主語放在「還」前面。
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + Clause 1，Subject + 還 + Clause 2

columns.pinyin: hái sòng gěi tā yí liàng chē

text.traditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，還喜歡吃香蕉。
text.simplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，还喜欢吃香蕉。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chúle xǐhuān chī píngguǒ, hái xǐhuān chī xiāngjiāo.
text.english: Besides liking to eat apples, I also like to eat bananas.

text.traditional: 很多人喜歡來這裡旅行，除了風景很好，交通還很方便。
text.simplified: 很多人喜欢来这里旅行，除了风景很好，交通还很方便。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xǐhuān lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng, chúle fēngjǐng hěn hǎo, jiāotōng hái hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Many people like to travel here. Besides the nice scenery, the transportation is also convenient.

text.traditional: A：白小姐生日的時候，男朋友送給她一個很貴的皮包。B：除了皮包，還送給她一輛車呢！
text.simplified: A：白小姐生日的时候，男朋友送给她一个很贵的皮包。B：除了皮包，还送给她一辆车呢！
text.pinyin: A: Bái xiǎojiě shēngrì de shíhou, nánpéngyou sòng gěi tā yí ge hěn guì de píbāo. B: Chúle píbāo, hái sòng gěi tā yí liàng chē ne!
text.english: A: On Miss Bai's birthday, her boyfriend gave her a very expensive purse. B: Besides the purse, he also gave her a car!

items.question: Where does 還 go?
items.answer: 「還」放在第二個動詞或形容詞前面：還喜歡吃香蕉。
items.wrongTraditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，喜歡吃香蕉還。
items.wrongSimplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，喜欢吃香蕉还。

right.traditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，還喜歡吃香蕉。
right.simplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，还喜欢吃香蕉。
right.pinyin: Wǒ chúle xǐhuān chī píngguǒ, hái xǐhuān chī xiāngjiāo.
right.english: Besides liking apples, I also like bananas.

items.question: When the two subjects are different, where does the second subject go?
items.answer: 第二個主語放在「還」前面：交通還很方便。
items.wrongTraditional: 除了風景很好，還交通很方便。
items.wrongSimplified: 除了风景很好，还交通很方便。

right.traditional: 除了風景很好，交通還很方便。
right.simplified: 除了风景很好，交通还很方便。
right.pinyin: Chúle fēngjǐng hěn hǎo, jiāotōng hái hěn fāngbiàn.
right.english: Besides the scenery being nice, the transportation is also convenient.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 那棟公寓看起來不錯，你為什麼不租？
，還要自己裝網路，所以我不要租。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！房租太貴是不要租的原因；「還」前面說另一個原因。
questions.repairFeedback: 句子說「還要自己裝網路，所以我不要租」，前面要說一個不租的原因。

items.prompt: There is a convenience store and a supermarket outside the school. Answer with 除了…還….

promptZh.traditional: 學校外面有便利商店，也有超市。用「除了…還…」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 学校外面有便利商店，也有超市。用「除了…还…」回答。

segments.traditional: 學校外面有沒有便利商店？
segments.simplified: 学校外面有没有便利商店？

repairs.note: With 除了, use 還有 for the second point; 也 alone does not add the supermarket.
但是 marks contrast; the supermarket is an addition.
因為 gives a reason; here you are adding a second place.
還有 introduces the second item; it comes after the first.
除了 introduces the first item, not the second.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 有 + 除了 + 便利商店 + 還有 + 超市.

result.traditional: 有，除了便利商店，還有超市。
result.simplified: 有，除了便利商店，还有超市。
result.pinyin: Yǒu, chúle biànlì shāngdiàn, hái yǒu chāoshì.
result.english: Yes; besides the convenience store, there is also a supermarket.

items.prompt: The rent for that apartment is $15,000 a month. Answer with 除了…還….

promptZh.traditional: 那棟公寓的房租一個月一萬五千塊。用「除了…還…」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 那栋公寓的房租一个月一万五千块。用「除了…还…」回答。

segments.traditional: 那棟公寓看起來不錯，你為什麼不租？
segments.simplified: 那栋公寓看起来不错，你为什么不租？

segments.traditional: ，還要自己裝網路，所以我不要租。
segments.simplified: ，还要自己装网路，所以我不要租。

repairs.note: Cheap rent is a reason to rent, but the sentence says you will not rent.
A good environment is a reason to rent; the sentence gives reasons not to.
With 除了, the second reason takes 還, not 也.
房租太貴 is the reason; it comes after 除了.
除了 introduces the reason; it comes before 房租太貴.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 除了 before 房租太貴.

result.traditional: 除了房租太貴，還要自己裝網路，所以我不要租。
result.simplified: 除了房租太贵，还要自己装网路，所以我不要租。
result.pinyin: Chúle fángzū tài guì, hái yào zìjǐ zhuāng wǎnglù, suǒyǐ wǒ bú yào zū.
result.english: Besides the rent being too expensive, I would also have to set up the internet myself, so I do not want to rent it.

items.prompt: Your roommate stays up late at night, makes the room dirty, and is loud. Answer with 除了…還….

promptZh.traditional: 室友晚上不睡覺，房間也弄得很髒，聲音很大。用「除了…還…」回答。
promptZh.simplified: 室友晚上不睡觉，房间也弄得很脏，声音很大。用「除了…还…」回答。

segments.traditional: 你為什麼要搬出去？宿舍不好嗎？
segments.simplified: 你为什么要搬出去？宿舍不好吗？

repairs.note: The problem is the roommate habits, not the weather.
A quiet roommate would not make you move out.
The pattern needs the roommate's habit here; 環境 is not a habit.
很吵 is the comment after 他還; it belongs in the second blank.
生活習慣 is the habit noun; it belongs in the first blank.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 除了 + 生活習慣 + 不一樣, 他還 + 很吵.

result.traditional: 我跟室友除了生活習慣不一樣，他還很吵，所以我要搬家。
result.simplified: 我跟室友除了生活习惯不一样，他还很吵，所以我要搬家。
result.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu chúle shēnghuó xíguàn bù yíyàng, tā hái hěn chǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ yào bānjiā.
result.english: Besides having different living habits, my roommate is also very noisy, so I want to move.

items.prompt: You like tea and also like coffee. Say it with 除了…還….

promptZh.traditional: 你喜歡喝茶，也喜歡喝咖啡。用「除了…還…」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你喜欢喝茶，也喜欢喝咖啡。用「除了…还…」说。

sentence.traditional: 我除了茶，還喜歡咖啡。
sentence.simplified: 我除了茶，还喜欢咖啡。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ chúle chá, hái xǐhuān kāfēi.
sentence.english: Besides tea, I also like coffee.

sentence.traditional: 除了茶，我還喜歡咖啡。
sentence.simplified: 除了茶，我还喜欢咖啡。
sentence.pinyin: Chúle chá, wǒ hái xǐhuān kāfēi.
sentence.english: Besides tea, I also like coffee.

repairs.note: 但是 marks contrast; coffee is an addition, not a contrast.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我 + 除了 + 茶 + 還喜歡 + 咖啡.

items.prompt: The food at this restaurant is quite good, and it is comfortable inside. Say it with 除了…還….

promptZh.traditional: 這家餐廳的菜很不錯，裡面也很舒服。用「除了…還…」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这家餐厅的菜很不错，里面也很舒服。用「除了…还…」说。

repairs.note: The restaurant's food, not the weather, is the first point.
很安靜 is a comment; the second blank needs the thing that is nice: 環境.
環境 is the thing that is nice; it belongs in the second blank, before 還.
菜很好吃 is the first point after 除了; it belongs in the first blank.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 這家餐廳除了 + 菜很好吃, 環境 + 還很好.

result.traditional: 這家餐廳除了菜很好吃，環境還很好。
result.simplified: 这家餐厅除了菜很好吃，环境还很好。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng chúle cài hěn hǎochī, huánjìng hái hěn hǎo.
result.english: Besides the food being good, this restaurant's environment is also very nice.

items.successNote: With different subjects, put the second subject (環境) before 還.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with V得 + comment
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 with V得 to say how an action leaves something.
grammarPages.explanation: 「把」後面的動作動詞加「得」，再接程度或結果：把足球踢得很遠、把問題弄得更麻煩。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + 得 + Adv + Adjective

text.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
text.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
text.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
text.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

text.traditional: 他把那隻兔子畫得很可愛。
text.simplified: 他把那只兔子画得很可爱。
text.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà zhī tùzi huà de hěn kě'ài.
text.english: He drew that rabbit very cute.

text.traditional: 請你不要把這個問題弄得更麻煩。
text.simplified: 请你不要把这个问题弄得更麻烦。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ búyào bǎ zhège wèntí nòng de gèng máfan.
text.english: Please don't make this problem even more troublesome.

items.question: Where does 得 go?
items.answer: 「得」放在動詞後面，再接程度或結果：踢得很遠。
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟把足球得踢很遠。
items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟把足球得踢很远。

right.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
right.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
right.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
right.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

items.question: Does the object go after 把 or after the verb?
items.answer: 要處理的東西放在「把」後面：把足球踢得很遠。
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟踢得足球很遠。
items.wrongSimplified: 弟弟踢得足球很远。

right.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
right.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
right.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
right.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！要處理的對象「臥室」放在「把」後面。
questions.repairFeedback: 「把」後面接對象，再接動詞和「得」。

items.prompt: Your sister cleaned the bedroom yesterday; it is very clean now. Say it with 把 and 得.

promptZh.traditional: 妹妹昨天打掃臥室，現在很乾淨。用「把」和「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 妹妹昨天打扫卧室，现在很干净。用「把」和「得」说。

sentence.traditional: 妹妹昨天把臥室打掃得很乾淨。
sentence.simplified: 妹妹昨天把卧室打扫得很干净。
sentence.pinyin: Mèimei zuótiān bǎ wòshì dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.
sentence.english: My sister cleaned the bedroom until it was very clean yesterday.

repairs.note: 打掃完 means finished cleaning; the comment 很乾淨 needs 得.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 妹妹昨天 + 把臥室 + 打掃 + 得 + 很乾淨.

items.prompt: He writes his name and it looks very bad. Ask him why.

promptZh.traditional: 他寫自己的名字，看起來很難看。你問他為什麼。
promptZh.simplified: 他写自己的名字，看起来很难看。你问他为什么。

segments.traditional: 你為什麼把自己的名字
segments.simplified: 你为什么把自己的名字

repairs.note: 寫得 joins the verb and 得; here 寫 and 得 each have their own place.
了 marks a finished action; the comment 那麼難看 needs 得.
得 follows the verb; put 寫 first.
那麼難看 is the comment; it comes after 得.
寫 is the verb; it fills the first blank.
那麼難看 is the comment; it comes after 得.
寫 is the verb; it fills the first blank.
得 goes between the verb and the comment, in the second blank.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 寫 + 得 + 那麼難看: 你為什麼把自己的名字寫得那麼難看？
items.successNote: 寫 and 得 are separate words: 寫 + 得 + the comment.

result.traditional: 你為什麼把自己的名字寫得那麼難看？
result.simplified: 你为什么把自己的名字写得那么难看？
result.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bǎ zìjǐ de míngzi xiě de nàme nánkàn?
result.english: Why do you write your own name so badly?

items.prompt: Miss Lin's new home is very pretty. Say it with 把 and 得.

promptZh.traditional: 林小姐的新家很漂亮。用「把」和「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 林小姐的新家很漂亮。用「把」和「得」说。

repairs.note: 弄得 joins the verb and 得; here 弄 and 得 each have their own place.
了 marks a finished action; the comment 很漂亮 needs 得.
得 follows the verb; put 弄 first.
很漂亮 is the comment; it comes after 得.
弄 is the verb; it fills the first blank.
很漂亮 is the comment; it comes after 得.
弄 is the verb; it fills the first blank.
得 goes between the verb and the comment, in the second blank.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 弄 + 得 + 很漂亮: 林小姐把新家的客廳弄得很漂亮。
items.successNote: 弄 and 得 are separate words: 弄 + 得 + the comment.

result.traditional: 林小姐把新家的客廳弄得很漂亮。
result.simplified: 林小姐把新家的客厅弄得很漂亮。
result.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě bǎ xīn jiā de kètīng nòng de hěn piàoliàng.
result.english: Miss Lin made the living room of her new home very pretty.

items.prompt: Your brother kicked the soccer ball; the ball went far away.

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟踢足球，球跑到很遠的地方。
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟踢足球，球跑到很远的地方。

repairs.note: 了 marks a finished action; the comment 很遠 needs 得.
踢 alone does not connect to the comment 很遠; use 踢得.

items.hint: The comment 很遠 needs the degree pattern, not a finished-action marker.

result.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
result.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
result.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
result.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 踢了 leaves 弟弟把足球很遠, which has no verb.

items.prompt: This matter is already strange. Tell him not to make it stranger. Say it with 把 and 得.

promptZh.traditional: 這件事已經很奇怪。你叫他不要再弄。用「把」和「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这件事已经很奇怪。你叫他不要再弄。用「把」和「得」说。

sentence.traditional: 請你不要把這件事弄得更奇怪。
sentence.simplified: 请你不要把这件事弄得更奇怪。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ búyào bǎ zhè jiàn shì nòng de gèng qíguài.
sentence.english: Please do not make this matter even stranger.

repairs.note: 更 is already in 弄得更; do not repeat it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 請你 + 不要 + 把這件事 + 弄得更 + 奇怪.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · It’s Fun to Go to the Night Market

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （可欣約美心一起去逛夜市）
lines.simplified: （可欣约美心一起去逛夜市）
lines.pinyin: （Kěxīn yuē Měixīn yìqǐ qù guàng yèshì）
lines.english: (Kexin invites Meixin to go to the night market together.)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 妳平常不愛逛夜市，今天怎麼忽然想去啊？
lines.simplified: 你平常不爱逛夜市，今天怎么忽然想去啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng bú ài guàng yèshì, jīntiān zěnme hūrán xiǎng qù a?
lines.english: You don't usually like to go to night markets. Why do you suddenly want to go today?

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 因為良介說他跟朋友都想到夜市看看，請我給他們介紹介紹台灣的小吃。
