lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 我住的地方叫「幸福社區」，這個社區在台北市的郊區，我跟妹妹都是在這裡長大的。雖然社區很大，環境很好，可是因為在山上，走起路來很辛苦，所以每次出門，都得搭社區的小巴士。還好巴士每十五分鐘就有一班，要不然就會很麻煩。
lines.simplified: 我住的地方叫「幸福社区」，这个社区在台北市的郊区，我跟妹妹都是在这里长大的。虽然社区很大，环境很好，可是因为在山上，走起路来很辛苦，所以每次出门，都得搭社区的小巴士。还好巴士每十五分钟就有一班，要不然就会很麻烦。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jiào 「Xìngfú Shèqū」, zhège shèqū zài Táiběi Shì de jiāoqū, wǒ gēn mèimei dōu shì zài zhèlǐ zhǎngdà de. Suīrán shèqū hěn dà, huánjìng hěn hǎo, kěshì yīnwèi zài shān shàng, zǒu qǐ lù lái hěn xīnkǔ, suǒyǐ měi cì chūmén, dōu děi dā shèqū de xiǎo bāshì. Háihǎo bāshì měi shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù yǒu yì bān, yàobùrán jiù huì hěn máfán.
lines.english: The place where I live is called “Happy Community”. This community is in the suburbs of Taipei City. My younger sister and I grew up here. Although the community is very big and the environment is very good, it is located in the mountains, and we have a hard time walking along the road. Therefore, every time we go out, we have to take the community’s minibus. Fortunately, the bus comes every fifteen minutes; otherwise it would be very troublesome.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 幸福社區很安全，如果有客人來，都得經過大門口，門口的安全人員覺得沒有問題了，才可以進來。這個社區也有很大的草地、漂亮的花園和新鮮的空氣。客人到了這裡，就像到了公園一樣輕鬆。花園旁邊有一家書店跟二十四小時的超級市場，超市的停車場可以停很多車，停多久都不需要付停車費。
lines.simplified: 幸福社区很安全，如果有客人来，都得经过大门口，门口的安全人员觉得没有问题了，才可以进来。这个社区也有很大的草地、漂亮的花园和新鲜的空气。客人到了这里，就像到了公园一样轻松。花园旁边有一家书店跟二十四小时的超级市场，超市的停车场可以停很多车，停多久都不需要付停车费。
lines.pinyin: Xìngfú shèqū hěn ānquán, rúguǒ yǒu kèrén lái, dōu děi jīngguò dàménkǒu, ménkǒu de ānquán rényuán juéde méiyǒu wèntí le, cái kěyǐ jìnlái. Zhège shèqū yě yǒu hěn dà de cǎodì, piàoliang de huāyuán hé xīnxiān de kōngqì. Kèrén dào le zhèlǐ, jiù xiàng dào le gōngyuán yíyàng qīngsōng. Huāyuán pángbiān yǒu yì jiā shūdiàn gēn èrshísì xiǎoshí de chāojí shìchǎng, chāoshì de tíngchēchǎng kěyǐ tíng hěn duō chē, tíng duō jiǔ dōu bù xūyào fù tíngchēfèi.
lines.english: Happy Community is very safe. If there are guests coming in, they must pass through the main gate. Only if the security guard at the gate thinks there is no problem can they get in. This community also has a big lawn, a beautiful garden, and fresh air. When guests come here, it is just like they come to a park, they feel relaxed. Next to the garden there is a bookstore and a 24-hour supermarket. The parking lot of the supermarket can accommodate a lot of cars. No matter how long you park, you don’t need to pay the parking fee.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 每年的中秋節，社區的人都會坐在草地上，一邊看著又大又圓的月亮，一邊吃著又香又甜的月餅，開心極了！我覺得住在這裡真是太幸福了，你想不想搬來當我的鄰居呢？
lines.simplified: 每年的中秋节，社区的人都会坐在草地上，一边看着又大又圆的月亮，一边吃着又香又甜的月饼，开心极了！我觉得住在这里真是太幸福了，你想不想搬来当我的邻居呢？
lines.pinyin: Měi nián de Zhōngqiū jié, shèqū de rén dōu huì zuò zài cǎodì shàng, yìbiān kànzhe yòu dà yòu yuán de yuèliàng, yìbiān chīzhe yòu xiāng yòu tián de yuèbǐng, kāixīn jí le! Wǒ juéde zhù zài zhèlǐ zhēnshi tài xìngfú le, nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng bān lái dāng wǒ de línjū ne?
lines.english: On Mid-Autumn Festival every year, people living in the community would sit on the lawn watching the big and round moon and eating fragrant and sweet moon cakes with great joy! I am really happy to live here. Do you want to move here and become my neighbor?

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Vs起來 / V起（O）來: start and keep going
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an action or state starts and keeps going.
grammarPages.explanation: 「Vs起來／V起（O）來」表示動作或狀態開始並持續；有賓語時，賓語放在「起」和「來」之間，例如「跳起舞來」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Vs起來 / V起 (O) 來

columns.pinyin: jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le
zěnme wán qǐ shǒujī lái le
columns.meaning: why started playing with the phone

text.traditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就熱鬧起來了。
text.simplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就热闹起来了。
text.pinyin: Dào le xiàwǔ sì, wǔ diǎn, yèshì jiù rènao qǐlái le.
text.english: At four or five in the afternoon, the night market became lively.

text.traditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起舞來了。
text.simplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起舞来了。
text.pinyin: Nàge háizi yì tīngdào yīnyuè, jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le.
text.english: As soon as that child heard the music, he started dancing.

text.traditional: 現在在上課，你怎麼玩起手機來了？
text.simplified: 现在在上课，你怎么玩起手机来了？
text.pinyin: Xiànzài zài shàngkè, nǐ zěnme wán qǐ shǒujī lái le?
text.english: We’re in class now—why have you started playing with your phone?

items.question: 要說夜市開始熱鬧，用「起來」還是「極了」？
items.answer: 「起來」表示開始並持續；「極了」表示程度最高。
items.wrongTraditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就開始熱鬧極了。
items.wrongSimplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就开始热闹极了。

right.traditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就熱鬧起來了。
right.simplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就热闹起来了。
right.pinyin: Dào le xiàwǔ sì, wǔ diǎn, yèshì jiù rènao qǐlái le.
right.english: At four or five in the afternoon, the night market became lively.

items.question: 有賓語時，「起來」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 賓語要放在「起」和「來」中間：跳起舞來、下起雨來。
items.wrongTraditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起來舞了。
items.wrongSimplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起来舞了。

right.traditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起舞來了。
right.simplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起舞来了。
right.pinyin: Nàge háizi yì tīngdào yīnyuè, jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le.
right.english: As soon as that child heard the music, he started dancing.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就

questions.correctFeedback: 「熱鬧起來了」表示夜市開始熱鬧並持續到半夜。
questions.repairFeedback: 「熱鬧極了」只說程度高，不能表示開始並持續。

items.prompt: When Yamamoto is shy, his face turns red. Say it with 起來.

promptZh.traditional: 山本良介害羞的時候，臉就紅了。用「起來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 山本良介害羞的时候，脸就红了。用「起来」说。

items.sub: 山本良介害羞的時候，臉就____。

segments.traditional: 山本良介害羞的時候，臉就
segments.simplified: 山本良介害羞的时候，脸就

repairs.note: 紅了 just says red; 起來 shows the face started to get red.
Add 來: 紅起來了.
很紅 describes a state; 起來 shows the change.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 臉就紅起來了.

result.traditional: 山本良介害羞的時候，臉就紅起來了。
result.simplified: 山本良介害羞的时候，脸就红起来了。
result.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hàixiū de shíhou, liǎn jiù hóng qǐlái le.
result.english: When Ryosuke Yamamoto is shy, his face turns red.

items.successNote: Vs起來了 shows a state starting.

items.prompt: It is not lunchtime yet. Ask why she has started eating.

promptZh.traditional: 還不到中午，她就開始吃了。用「起來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 还不到中午，她就开始吃了。用「起来」说。

items.sub: A：還不到中午吃飯的時間，妳怎麼____？

segments.traditional: 還不到中午吃飯的時間，妳怎麼
segments.simplified: 还不到中午吃饭的时间，妳怎么

repairs.note: 吃了 asks about a finished action; 起來了 shows she has started.
Add 來: 吃起來了.
The sentence needs 起來了 to show the start.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 怎麼吃起來了？

result.traditional: 還不到中午吃飯的時間，妳怎麼吃起來了？
result.simplified: 还不到中午吃饭的时间，妳怎么吃起来了？
result.pinyin: Hái bú dào zhōngwǔ chīfàn de shíjiān, nǐ zěnme chī qǐlái le?
result.english: It is not even lunchtime yet; why have you started eating?

items.successNote: V起來了 shows an action starting.

items.prompt: The morning weather was nice, but it started to rain in the afternoon. Say it with 起來.

promptZh.traditional: 早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午開始下雨了。用「起來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 早上天气不错，没想到下午开始下雨了。用「起来」说。

items.sub: B：是啊！早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午就____。

segments.traditional: 是啊！早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午就
segments.simplified: 是啊！早上天气不错，没想到下午就

repairs.note: 下雨了 says it rained; 下起雨來了 shows it started.
The sentence needs 起來了 to show the start.
下起雨 comes before 來了: 下起雨來了.
來了 closes the phrase after 雨.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 下起雨來了.

result.traditional: 是啊！早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午就下起雨來了。
result.simplified: 是啊！早上天气不错，没想到下午就下起雨来了。
result.pinyin: Shì a! Zǎoshang tiānqì búcuò, méi xiǎngdào xiàwǔ jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
result.english: Right! The morning weather was nice; I did not expect it to start raining in the afternoon.

items.successNote: With an object, it goes between 起 and 來: 下起雨來.

items.prompt: The child started singing when he heard the music. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說那個孩子一聽到音樂，就開始唱歌了。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说那个孩子一听到音乐，就开始唱歌了。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: 唱起來歌 puts 歌 after 來; the object goes between 起 and 來: 唱起歌來.
唱了歌 would give 唱了歌了; use 唱起歌來.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; 歌 belongs between 起 and 來.
items.hint: With an object, put it between 起 and 來.

result.traditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就唱起歌來了。
result.simplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就唱起歌来了。
result.pinyin: Nàge háizi yì tīngdào yīnyuè, jiù chàng qǐ gē lái le.
result.english: As soon as that child heard the music, he started singing.

items.successNote: V起(O)來: the object sits between 起 and 來.

items.prompt: In the evening the park becomes lively. Say it with 起來.

sentence.traditional: 那個孩子一聽到音樂，就跳起舞來了。
sentence.simplified: 那个孩子一听到音乐，就跳起舞来了。
sentence.pinyin: Nàge háizi yì tīngdào yīnyuè, jiù tiào qǐ wǔ lái le.
sentence.english: As soon as that child heard the music, he started dancing.

cards.note: 跳起舞來 shows the dancing started.

sentence.traditional: 到了下午四、五點，夜市就熱鬧起來了。
sentence.simplified: 到了下午四、五点，夜市就热闹起来了。
sentence.pinyin: Dào le xiàwǔ sì, wǔ diǎn, yèshì jiù rènao qǐlái le.
sentence.english: At four or five in the afternoon, the night market becomes lively.

cards.note: 熱鬧起來了 shows the market became lively.

items.successNote: 看起來 judges how something seems; V/S起來了 shows it started.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what you are lucky happened, and what would have happened otherwise.
grammarPages.explanation: 「還好……，要不然……」表示慶幸前面的好情況；如果沒有它，後面「要不然」的壞結果就可能發生。
grammarPages.pattern: 還好 + Good situation, 要不然 + Bad result

columns.pinyin: jiù bù néng qù lùyíng le
shénme dōngxi dōu bù néng mǎi le
jiù děi zài kǎo yí cì le
columns.meaning: then I’d have to take it again

text.traditional: 還好今天沒下雨，要不然就不能去露營了。
text.simplified: 还好今天没下雨，要不然就不能去露营了。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo jīntiān méi xiàyǔ, yàobùrán jiù bù néng qù lùyíng le.
text.english: Fortunately it didn’t rain today; otherwise we couldn’t go camping.

text.traditional: 還好我帶了錢，要不然什麼東西都不能買了。
text.simplified: 还好我带了钱，要不然什么东西都不能买了。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ dài le qián, yàobùrán shénme dōngxi dōu bù néng mǎi le.
text.english: Fortunately I brought money; otherwise I couldn’t buy anything.

text.traditional: 還好我的期中考成績不錯，要不然就得再考一次了。
text.simplified: 还好我的期中考成绩不错，要不然就得再考一次了。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ de qízhōngkǎo chéngjī búcuò, yàobùrán jiù děi zài kǎo yí cì le.
text.english: Fortunately my midterm grade was good; otherwise I’d have to take it again.

items.question: 「還好」後面接好情況還是壞結果？
items.answer: 「還好」後面接值得慶幸的好情況；「要不然」後面才是可能發生的壞結果。
items.wrongTraditional: 還好不能去露營了，要不然今天沒下雨。
items.wrongSimplified: 还好不能去露营了，要不然今天没下雨。

right.traditional: 還好今天沒下雨，要不然就不能去露營了。
right.simplified: 还好今天没下雨，要不然就不能去露营了。
right.pinyin: Háihǎo jīntiān méi xiàyǔ, yàobùrán jiù bù néng qù lùyíng le.
right.english: Fortunately it didn’t rain today; otherwise we couldn’t go camping.

items.question: 「還好」和「但是」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「還好」表示慶幸；「但是」只表示轉折。
items.wrongTraditional: 但是我帶了錢，要不然什麼東西都不能買了。
items.wrongSimplified: 但是我带了钱，要不然什么东西都不能买了。

right.traditional: 還好我帶了錢，要不然什麼東西都不能買了。
right.simplified: 还好我带了钱，要不然什么东西都不能买了。
right.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ dài le qián, yàobùrán shénme dōngxi dōu bù néng mǎi le.
right.english: Fortunately I brought money; otherwise I couldn’t buy anything.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 今天沒下雨，要不然就不能去露營了。

questions.correctFeedback: 「還好」表示慶幸今天沒下雨。
questions.repairFeedback: 「但是」只表示轉折，不能表達慶幸。

items.prompt: There are many people buying movie tickets. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 買電影票的人很多。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 买电影票的人很多。用「还好……要不然……」说。

items.sub: A：你看，今天排隊買電影票的人真多！

repairs.note: Coming late would make it harder to buy tickets.
The first line says there are many people, so 人不多 contradicts it.
來得早 is the full phrase; 早 alone does not fit after 我們.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好我們 + 來得早.

result.traditional: 是啊！還好我們來得早，要不然一定買不到。
result.simplified: 是啊！还好我们来得早，要不然一定买不到。
result.pinyin: Shì a! Háihǎo wǒmen lái de zǎo, yàobùrán yídìng mǎi bú dào.
result.english: Right! Fortunately we came early; otherwise we definitely could not buy tickets.

items.successNote: 還好 names the good thing; 要不然 names the bad result without it.

items.prompt: This community has security staff. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 這個社區有安全人員。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这个社区有安全人员。用「还好……要不然……」说。

items.sub: A：這個社區安全嗎？

segments.traditional: 還好有安全人員，要不然一定很
segments.simplified: 还好有安全人员，要不然一定很

repairs.note: 要不然 introduces the bad result; it is not safe.
了 marks a change; the sentence describes a state.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 要不然一定很不安全.

result.traditional: 還好有安全人員，要不然一定很不安全。
result.simplified: 还好有安全人员，要不然一定很不安全。
result.pinyin: Háihǎo yǒu ānquán rényuán, yàobùrán yídìng hěn bù ānquán.
result.english: Fortunately there are security staff; otherwise it would definitely be unsafe.

items.successNote: 還好 gives the good situation; 要不然 gives the bad alternative.

items.prompt: The scholarship is 20,000 a month and the rent is 5,000 a month. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 獎學金一個月兩萬塊，房租一個月五千塊。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 奖学金一个月两万块，房租一个月五千块。用「还好……要不然……」说。

items.sub: A：你的獎學金一個月兩萬塊，夠嗎？

repairs.note: 很貴 would make 還好 wrong: cheap rent is the good thing.
要不然 introduces the bad result, so it is not enough.
不夠了 is the bad result; it goes after 要不然就, not after 房租.
不貴 describes the rent; it goes after 房租, before 要不然.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好房租不貴，要不然就不夠了.

result.traditional: 還好房租不貴，要不然就不夠了。
result.simplified: 还好房租不贵，要不然就不够了。
result.pinyin: Háihǎo fángzū bú guì, yàobùrán jiù bú gòu le.
result.english: Fortunately the rent is not expensive; otherwise it would not be enough.

items.successNote: 還好 + good fact, 要不然 + the bad result.

items.prompt: You brought your phone, so you can find the way. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 你帶了手機，所以找得到路。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你带了手机，所以找得到路。用「还好……要不然……」说。

sentence.traditional: 還好帶了手機，要不然就找不到路了。
sentence.simplified: 还好带了手机，要不然就找不到路了。
sentence.pinyin: Háihǎo dài le shǒujī, yàobùrán jiù zhǎo bú dào lù le.
sentence.english: Fortunately I brought my phone; otherwise I could not find the way.

repairs.note: 但是 only contrasts; this sentence shows relief about what did not happen.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好 + 帶了手機 + 要不然 + 就找不到 + 路了.

items.prompt: There is a bus, so going up the hill is not hard. Say it with 還好……要不然…….

promptZh.traditional: 有巴士，所以上山不辛苦。用「還好……要不然……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 有巴士，所以上山不辛苦。用「还好……要不然……」说。

sentence.traditional: 還好有巴士，要不然走路上山很辛苦。
sentence.simplified: 还好有巴士，要不然走路上山很辛苦。
sentence.pinyin: Háihǎo yǒu bāshì, yàobùrán zǒulù shàngshān hěn xīnkǔ.
sentence.english: Fortunately there is a bus; otherwise walking up the hill would be hard.

repairs.note: 所以 gives a direct result; 要不然 gives what would happen without the good thing.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還好 + 有巴士 + 要不然 + 走路上山 + 很辛苦.
items.successNote: 還好 names the good thing; 要不然 names the bad result without it.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: 每 + time + verb + frequency: how often
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how often something happens with 每.
grammarPages.explanation: 「每＋數量＋動詞＋數量」表示固定頻率；加「就」強調動作發生得規律或頻繁。
grammarPages.pattern: 每 + Nu + M₁ (+ 就) + V + Nu + M₂ (+ N)

text.traditional: 我們的中文課每四課考一次（試）。
text.simplified: 我们的中文课每四课考一次（试）。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè měi sì kè kǎo yí cì (shì).
text.english: Our Chinese class has a test every four lessons.

text.traditional: 山本良介每半年就回一次日本。
text.simplified: 山本良介每半年就回一次日本。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè měi bàn nián jiù huí yí cì Rìběn.
text.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto returns to Japan once every half year.

text.traditional: 我朋友很喜歡牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
text.simplified: 我朋友很喜欢牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
text.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou hěn xǐhuan niúròu, měi sān tiān jiù chī yí cì niúpái.
text.english: My friend really likes beef and eats steak once every three days.

items.question: 「每四課考一次」的「一次」可以放在動詞前面嗎？
items.answer: 不行。次數要放在動詞後面：考一次、回一次。
items.wrongTraditional: 我們的中文課每四課一次考。
items.wrongSimplified: 我们的中文课每四课一次考。

right.traditional: 我們的中文課每四課考一次。
right.simplified: 我们的中文课每四课考一次。
right.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè měi sì kè kǎo yí cì.
right.english: Our Chinese class has a test every four lessons.

items.question: 「每」可以接具體的數量嗎？
items.answer: 可以，但「每」要放在數量前面，表示每三天一次、每四課一次。
items.wrongTraditional: 我朋友很喜歡牛肉，三天每就吃一次牛排。
items.wrongSimplified: 我朋友很喜欢牛肉，三天每就吃一次牛排。

right.traditional: 我朋友很喜歡牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
right.simplified: 我朋友很喜欢牛肉，每三天就吃一次牛排。
right.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou hěn xǐhuan niúròu, měi sān tiān jiù chī yí cì niúpái.
right.english: My friend really likes beef and eats steak once every three days.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 考一次（試），所以第十六課會考第四次。

questions.correctFeedback: 「每四課」表示每四課考一次，所以第十六課會考第四次。
questions.repairFeedback: 「第四課」只指某一課，不能表示每四課一次的頻率。

practice.title: Practice: 每 + Nu + M₁（+就）+ V + Nu + M₂

items.prompt: Mr. Zhang plays tennis once a week. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 張先生一個禮拜打一次網球。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 张先生一个礼拜打一次网球。用「每」说。

items.sub: 張先生一個禮拜打一次網球。

sentence.traditional: 張先生每個禮拜打一次網球。
sentence.simplified: 张先生每个礼拜打一次网球。
sentence.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng měi ge lǐbài dǎ yí cì wǎngqiú.
sentence.english: Mr. Zhang plays tennis once every week.

sentence.traditional: 每個禮拜張先生打一次網球。
sentence.simplified: 每个礼拜张先生打一次网球。
sentence.pinyin: Měi ge lǐbài Zhāng xiānsheng dǎ yí cì wǎngqiú.
sentence.english: Every week, Mr. Zhang plays tennis once.

repairs.note: 每天 means every day; he plays once a week.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 張先生 + 每個禮拜 + 打 + 一次 + 網球.
items.successNote: 每 + time + V + frequency.

items.prompt: His bathroom is clean because he cleans it on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為星期二、四、六都要打掃。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为星期二、四、六都要打扫。用「每」说。

items.sub: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為星期二、四、六都要打掃。

segments.traditional: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為
segments.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为

repairs.note: 星期二、四、六 is every two days, not every day.
兩天 needs 每 before it: 每兩天.
一次 is the frequency; it goes after the verb 打掃.
每兩天 is the frequency period; it goes before 就要打掃.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 因為每兩天就要打掃一次.

result.traditional: 他家的浴室很乾淨，因為每兩天就要打掃一次。
result.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为每两天就要打扫一次。
result.pinyin: Tā jiā de yùshì hěn gānjìng, yīnwèi měi liǎng tiān jiù yào dǎsǎo yí cì.
result.english: His bathroom is very clean because it is cleaned once every two days.

items.successNote: 每 + number + measure word gives the regular frequency.

items.prompt: The doctor says to rest after reading for thirty minutes. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 醫生說，看三十分鐘的書，就應該休息一下。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 医生说，看三十分钟的书，就应该休息一下。用「每」说。

items.sub: 醫生說，看三十分鐘的書，就應該休息一下。

sentence.traditional: 醫生說，每三十分鐘休息一次。
sentence.simplified: 医生说，每三十分钟休息一次。
sentence.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, měi sānshí fēnzhōng xiūxi yí cì.
sentence.english: The doctor says to rest once every thirty minutes.

repairs.note: The doctor says every thirty minutes, not every day.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 醫生說 + 每 + 三十分鐘 + 休息 + 一次.

items.prompt: Place 就 where it belongs.

promptZh.traditional: 把「就」放好。
promptZh.simplified: 把「就」放好。

repairs.note: 就 comes before the verb 回, not after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 就 before 回: 每半年就回一次日本.

result.traditional: 他每半年就回一次日本。
result.simplified: 他每半年就回一次日本。
result.pinyin: Tā měi bàn nián jiù huí yí cì Rìběn.
result.english: He goes back to Japan once every half year.

items.successNote: 就 goes before the verb; it emphasizes the regular frequency.

items.prompt: He goes back to Japan once a month. Say it with 每.

promptZh.traditional: 他一個月回一次日本。用「每」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他一个月回一次日本。用「每」说。

sentence.traditional: 他每個月回一次日本。
sentence.simplified: 他每个月回一次日本。
sentence.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè huí yí cì Rìběn.
sentence.english: He goes back to Japan once every month.

sentence.traditional: 每個月他回一次日本。
sentence.simplified: 每个月他回一次日本。
sentence.pinyin: Měi ge yuè tā huí yí cì Rìběn.
sentence.english: Every month, he goes back to Japan once.

repairs.note: 每天 means every day; he goes once a month.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 他 + 每個月 + 回 + 一次 + 日本.

items.prompt: My friend eats steak once every three days. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說他每三天吃一次牛排。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说他每三天吃一次牛排。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: 牛排 is what he eats; 一次 comes before it.
一次 belongs before 牛排, not after it.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; move 一次 before 牛排.
items.hint: The frequency 一次 comes before the food.

result.traditional: 我朋友每三天就吃一次牛排。
result.simplified: 我朋友每三天就吃一次牛排。
result.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou měi sān tiān jiù chī yí cì niúpái.
result.english: My friend eats steak once every three days.

items.successNote: 每 + time + 就 + V + frequency + object.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: A像B一樣 (+Vs): A is just like B
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that two people or things are alike.
grammarPages.explanation: 「A像B一樣（+Vs）」表示兩個人、事物或情況相似；要說明相似的地方，就把形容詞放在「一樣」後面。
grammarPages.pattern: A + 像 + B + 一樣 (+ Vs)

columns.traditional: 像金先生住的社區一樣
columns.simplified: 像金先生住的社区一样
columns.pinyin: xiàng Jīn xiānsheng zhù de shèqū yíyàng
columns.meaning: like the community Mr. Jin lives in

text.traditional: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社區一樣安全。
text.simplified: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社区一样安全。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de gōngyù xiàng Jīn xiānsheng zhù de shèqū yíyàng ānquán.
text.english: The apartment I live in is as safe as the community Mr. Jin lives in.

text.traditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅，真可愛！
text.simplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红，真可爱！
text.pinyin: Nàge háizi de liǎn xiàng píngguǒ yíyàng hóng, zhēn kě’ài!
text.english: That child’s face is red like an apple—so cute!

text.traditional: 哥哥愛吃牛肉麵，就像爸爸愛吃牛排一樣。
text.simplified: 哥哥爱吃牛肉面，就像爸爸爱吃牛排一样。
text.pinyin: Gēge ài chī niúròu miàn, jiù xiàng bàba ài chī niúpái yíyàng.
text.english: My older brother loves beef noodles, just like Dad loves steak.

text.traditional: 弟弟覺得逛百貨公司像參觀博物館一樣無聊，所以他不要去。
text.simplified: 弟弟觉得逛百货公司像参观博物馆一样无聊，所以他不要去。
text.pinyin: Dìdi juéde guàng bǎihuò gōngsī xiàng cānguān bówùguǎn yíyàng wúliáo, suǒyǐ tā bú yào qù.
text.english: My younger brother thinks going to a department store is as boring as visiting a museum, so he doesn’t want to go.

items.question: 「比」和「像……一樣」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「比」比較高低；「像……一樣」表示相似。
items.wrongTraditional: 我住的公寓比金先生住的社區一樣安全。
items.wrongSimplified: 我住的公寓比金先生住的社区一样安全。

right.traditional: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社區一樣安全。
right.simplified: 我住的公寓像金先生住的社区一样安全。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de gōngyù xiàng Jīn xiānsheng zhù de shèqū yíyàng ānquán.
right.english: The apartment I live in is as safe as the community Mr. Jin lives in.

items.question: 「一樣」可以放在形容詞後面嗎？
items.answer: 不行。「一樣」要放在形容詞前面：像蘋果一樣紅。
items.wrongTraditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果紅一樣。
items.wrongSimplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果红一样。

right.traditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅。
right.simplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红。
right.pinyin: Nàge háizi de liǎn xiàng píngguǒ yíyàng hóng.
right.english: That child’s face is red like an apple.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 「像……一樣」表示兩者相似。
questions.repairFeedback: 「比」用來比較高低，不能和「一樣」搭配。

items.prompt: At Mid-Autumn Festival, what is a Taiwanese mooncake as round as?

promptZh.traditional: 中秋節的時候，台灣的月餅像什麼一樣圓？
promptZh.simplified: 中秋节的时候，台湾的月饼像什么一样圆？

items.sub: 台灣的月餅像____一樣圓。

repairs.note: The Mid-Autumn mooncake is compared with the moon, not the sun.
Stars are not round like mooncakes.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像月亮一樣圓.

result.traditional: 台灣的月餅像月亮一樣圓。
result.simplified: 台湾的月饼像月亮一样圆。
result.pinyin: Táiwān de yuèbǐng xiàng yuèliàng yíyàng yuán.
result.english: Taiwanese mooncakes are as round as the moon.

items.successNote: 像 + B + 一樣 + Vs.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 用「像……一樣」把句子說好。
promptZh.simplified: 用「像……一样」把句子说好。

items.sub: 這種飲料的味道不錯，像____。

segments.traditional: 這種飲料的味道不錯，像
segments.simplified: 这种饮料的味道不错，像

repairs.note: Put 一樣 after the noun: 果汁一樣.
The comparison uses 一樣, not 很.
很 cannot come before 果汁 here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像果汁一樣.

result.traditional: 這種飲料的味道不錯，像果汁一樣。
result.simplified: 这种饮料的味道不错，像果汁一样。
result.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào de wèidào búcuò, xiàng guǒzhī yíyàng.
result.english: This drink tastes good; it is like juice.

items.successNote: 像 + B + 一樣 completes the comparison.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 用「像……一樣」把句子說好。
promptZh.simplified: 用「像……一样」把句子说好。

items.sub: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，像____。

segments.traditional: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，像
segments.simplified: 林小姐说话的声音很温柔，像

repairs.note: 一樣 comes after 媽媽.
Use 一樣, not 很, to finish the comparison.
很 does not fit before 媽媽.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像媽媽一樣.

result.traditional: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，像媽媽一樣。
result.simplified: 林小姐说话的声音很温柔，像妈妈一样。
result.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn wēnróu, xiàng māma yíyàng.
result.english: Ms. Lin's voice is very gentle, like Mom's.

items.successNote: The person compared with comes after 像; 一樣 closes the phrase.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 用「像……一樣」把句子說好。
promptZh.simplified: 用「像……一样」把句子说好。

items.sub: 我的同學覺得露營像野餐____。

segments.traditional: 我的同學覺得露營像野餐
segments.simplified: 我的同学觉得露营像野餐

repairs.note: Put 一樣 before the adjective: 一樣好玩.
The comparison needs 一樣 before 好玩.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 像野餐一樣好玩.

result.traditional: 我的同學覺得露營像野餐一樣好玩。
result.simplified: 我的同学觉得露营像野餐一样好玩。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngxué juéde lùyíng xiàng yěcān yíyàng hǎowán.
result.english: My classmate thinks camping is as fun as a picnic.

items.successNote: The shared quality comes after 一樣.

items.prompt: This drink is like juice, and the juice is also sweet. Say it with 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 這杯飲料像果汁，果汁也很甜。用「像……一樣」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这杯饮料像果汁，果汁也很甜。用「像……一样」说。

sentence.traditional: 這杯飲料像果汁一樣甜。
sentence.simplified: 这杯饮料像果汁一样甜。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè bēi yǐnliào xiàng guǒzhī yíyàng tián.
sentence.english: This drink is as sweet as juice.

repairs.note: 一樣 already links the two; do not add 很 before 甜.
This is a description, not a change; 了 is not needed.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 這杯飲料 + 像果汁 + 一樣 + 甜.

items.prompt: The child's face is as red as an apple. The sentence should say that.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友想說那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅。句子要說這個意思。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友想说那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红。句子要说这个意思。

repairs.note: The comparison needs 一樣 before 紅, not 很.
Red alone does not complete 像…一樣.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; the comparison needs 一樣紅.
items.hint: The shared quality follows 一樣.

result.traditional: 那個孩子的臉像蘋果一樣紅。
result.simplified: 那个孩子的脸像苹果一样红。
result.pinyin: Nàge háizi de liǎn xiàng píngguǒ yíyàng hóng.
result.english: That child's face is as red as an apple.

items.successNote: 像 + B + 一樣 + Vs puts the quality last.

items.prompt: Watching TV and listening to music both feel relaxing to you. Say it with 像……一樣.

promptZh.traditional: 你覺得看電視和聽音樂都很輕鬆。用「像……一樣」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你觉得看电视和听音乐都很轻松。用「像……一样」说。

sentence.traditional: 我覺得看電視像聽音樂一樣輕鬆。
sentence.simplified: 我觉得看电视像听音乐一样轻松。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ juéde kàn diànshì xiàng tīng yīnyuè yíyàng qīngsōng.
sentence.english: I think watching TV is as relaxing as listening to music.

sentence.traditional: 看電視我覺得像聽音樂一樣輕鬆。
sentence.simplified: 看电视我觉得像听音乐一样轻松。
sentence.pinyin: Kàn diànshì wǒ juéde xiàng tīng yīnyuè yíyàng qīngsōng.
sentence.english: Watching TV, I feel as relaxed as listening to music.

repairs.note: 一樣 already marks the comparison; 很 is not used before 輕鬆 here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我覺得 + 看電視 + 像聽音樂 + 一樣 + 輕鬆.
items.successNote: 像…一樣 can compare two actions, not just two things.

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 下星期六是可欣的生日，我們要怎麼慶祝呢？
lines.simplified: 下星期六是可欣的生日，我们要怎么庆祝呢？
lines.pinyin: Xià xīngqīliù shì Kěxīn de shēngrì, wǒmen yào zěnme qìngzhù ne?
lines.english: Next Saturday is Kexin's birthday. How are we going to celebrate it?

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 她愛唱歌，去KTV幫她過生日，好不好？
lines.simplified: 她爱唱歌，去KTV帮她过生日，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Tā ài chànggē, qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, hǎo bu hǎo?
lines.english: She loves singing. Let's go to a KTV bar and celebrate her birthday there, OK?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太好了！我很想看看台灣的KTV，聽說跟日本的有點兒不同。
lines.simplified: 太好了！我很想看看台湾的KTV，听说跟日本的有点儿不同。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ hěn xiǎng kànkan Táiwān de KTV, tīngshuō gēn Rìběn de yǒudiǎnr bùtóng.
lines.english: Great! I want to see the KTV in Taiwan. I heard it's a little bit different than in Japan.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我覺得都差不多，可是很多台灣的KTV可以吃到飽。
lines.simplified: 我觉得都差不多，可是很多台湾的KTV可以吃到饱。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dōu chàbùduō, kěshì hěn duō Táiwān de KTV kěyǐ chīdàobǎo.
lines.english: I think there's no big difference. But in many Taiwanese KTV bars, you can eat as much as you want.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？我沒聽過日本有吃到飽的KTV，不過，我去KTV的目的不是吃東西，是唱歌。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？我没听过日本有吃到饱的KTV，不过，我去KTV的目的不是吃东西，是唱歌。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ méi tīngguò Rìběn yǒu chīdàobǎo de KTV, búguò, wǒ qù KTV de mùdì bú shì chī dōngxi, shì chànggē.
lines.english: Really? I haven't heard about any all-you-can-eat KTV bar in Japan. But the purpose I go to the KTV is to sing, not to eat.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我聽說，日本人跟朋友去KTV的時候，每個人一次只能點一首歌，點好了就換下一個人，是真的嗎？
lines.simplified: 我听说，日本人跟朋友去KTV的时候，每个人一次只能点一首歌，点好了就换下一个人，是真的吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō, Rìběnrén gēn péngyou qù KTV de shíhou, měi ge rén yí cì zhǐ néng diǎn yì shǒu gē, diǎn hǎo le jiù huàn xià yí ge rén, shì zhēn de ma?
lines.english: I heard that when the Japanese go to KTV bars with friends, one person can order only one song each time. After ordering the song, it is another one's turn. Is that right?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 沒錯，跟台灣不一樣嗎？
lines.simplified: 没错，跟台湾不一样吗？
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò, gēn Táiwān bù yíyàng ma?
lines.english: That's right! Is it different from Taiwan?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我們喜歡大家合唱，這樣比較熱鬧，唱錯了也沒關係。
lines.simplified: 我们喜欢大家合唱，这样比较热闹，唱错了也没关系。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xǐhuan dàjiā héchàng, zhèyàng bǐjiào rènao, chàng cuò le yě méi guānxi.
lines.english: We like singing altogether. It's more lively that way and it doesn't matter if you sing it wrong.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 有一次我們在KTV唱歌，隔壁的人唱得好開心，又唱又跳，感覺地板都動起來了。
lines.simplified: 有一次我们在KTV唱歌，隔壁的人唱得好开心，又唱又跳，感觉地板都动起来了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì wǒmen zài KTV chànggē, gébì de rén chàng de hěn kāixīn, yòu chàng yòu tiào, gǎnjué dìbǎn dōu dòng qǐlái le.
lines.english: Once while we were singing in a KTV bar, the people next door were singing so happily. They were both singing and dancing. It felt like the floor was starting to move.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 聽美心說你很會唱歌，可以教我唱中文歌嗎？
lines.simplified: 听美心说你很会唱歌，可以教我唱中文歌吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīng Měixīn shuō nǐ hěn huì chànggē, kěyǐ jiāo wǒ chàng Zhōngwén gē ma?
lines.english: I heard from Meixin that you sing very well. Can you teach me how to sing Chinese songs?

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 沒問題，我先教你唱簡單的，你一定很快就學會了。
lines.simplified: 没问题，我先教你唱简单的，你一定很快就学会了。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ xiān jiāo nǐ chàng jiǎndān de, nǐ yídìng hěn kuài jiù xuéhuì le.
lines.english: No problem. I'll teach you to sing the simple ones first. You'll learn it very fast for sure.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 台灣的KTV也有很多日文歌曲，你可以選幾首拿手的，在可欣生日那天，唱給大家聽。
lines.simplified: 台湾的KTV也有很多日文歌曲，你可以选几首拿手的，在可欣生日那天，唱给大家听。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV yě yǒu hěn duō Rìwén gēqǔ, nǐ kěyǐ xuǎn jǐ shǒu náshǒu de, zài Kěxīn shēngrì nà tiān, chàng gěi dàjiā tīng.
lines.english: Taiwanese KTV bars have many Japanese songs, too. You can choose a few songs that you mastered and sing them for everyone on Kexin's birthday.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 可是我很容易緊張，要是唱不好怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 可是我很容易紧张，要是唱不好怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ hěn róngyì jǐnzhāng, yàoshi chàng bu hǎo zěnme bàn?
lines.english: But I get nervous very easily. What shall I do if I don't sing well?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 沒關係。我每次去KTV，總是把自己當歌星，想像那是我的演唱會，想唱什麼就唱什麼，自己開心最重要。
lines.simplified: 没关系。我每次去KTV，总是把自己当歌星，想象那是我的演唱会，想唱什么就唱什么，自己开心最重要。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi. Wǒ měi cì qù KTV, zǒngshì bǎ zìjǐ dāng gēxīng, xiǎngxiàng nà shì wǒ de yǎnchànghuì, xiǎng chàng shénme jiù chàng shénme, zìjǐ kāixīn zuì zhòngyào.
lines.english: It doesn't matter. Every time I go to a KTV bar, I always act like a singer and imagine that was my concert. I sing what I want to sing. My own happiness is the most important.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我看過一個日本的電視節目，在KTV唱歌的時候，用機器給唱歌的人打分數，這樣就可以知道自己唱得怎麼樣。
lines.simplified: 我看过一个日本的电视节目，在KTV唱歌的时候，用机器给唱歌的人打分数，这样就可以知道自己唱得怎么样。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kànguò yí ge Rìběn de diànshì jiémù, zài KTV chànggē de shíhou, yòng jīqì gěi chànggē de rén dǎ fēnshù, zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ chàng de zěnmeyàng.
lines.english: I've seen a Japanese TV show. While people were singing in a KTV bar, they used a machine to score the singing. In that way they could find out how well they sang.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 聽起來好像是考試，好可怕！
lines.simplified: 听起来好像是考试，好可怕！
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái hǎoxiàng shì kǎoshì, hǎo kěpà!
lines.english: It sounds like an exam. So scary!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 那種機器常常弄錯，有時候我覺得唱得不差，可是分數很低。
lines.simplified: 那种机器常常弄错，有时候我觉得唱得不差，可是分数很低。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhǒng jīqì chángcháng nòngcuò, yǒu shíhou wǒ juéde chàng de bù chà, kěshì fēnshù hěn dī.
lines.english: That kind of machine often goes wrong. Sometimes I think my singing is not bad, but the score is very low.

lines.speaker: 美心、明生
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈！
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈！
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā!
lines.english: Hahaha! (laughing)

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我們去KTV那天，我教你一些唱歌的方法吧！
lines.simplified: 我们去KTV那天，我教你一些唱歌的方法吧！
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen qù KTV nà tiān, wǒ jiāo nǐ yìxiē chànggē de fāngfǎ ba!
lines.english: Let me teach you some singing methods on the day we go to a KTV bar.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: （興奮地說）太棒了！我一定會好好練習的，這樣就不怕機器給我打分數了。
lines.simplified: （兴奋地说）太棒了！我一定会好好练习的，这样就不怕机器给我打分数了。
lines.pinyin: (Xīngfèn de shuō) Tài bàng le! Wǒ yídìng huì hǎohǎo liànxí de, zhèyàng jiù bú pà jīqì gěi wǒ dǎ fēnshù le.
lines.english: (says excitedly) Awesome! I will definitely practice well, so I am not afraid of the machine giving me a score.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 對了，我們要買什麼禮物送給可欣呢？
lines.simplified: 对了，我们要买什么礼物送给可欣呢？
lines.pinyin: Duì le, wǒmen yào mǎi shénme lǐwù sòng gěi Kěxīn ne?
lines.english: By the way, what gifts are we going to give Kexin?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （大家想一想）
lines.simplified: （大家想一想）
lines.pinyin: (Dàjiā xiǎng yi xiǎng)
lines.english: (Everyone was thinking...)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 我想到了！可欣很喜歡香水，我們送她一瓶香水吧。
lines.simplified: 我想到了！可欣很喜欢香水，我们送她一瓶香水吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngdào le! Kěxīn hěn xǐhuan xiāngshuǐ, wǒmen sòng tā yì píng xiāngshuǐ ba.
lines.english: I have an idea! Kexin likes perfume. Let's give her a bottle of perfume.

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 我還要送她巧克力跟一大束紅玫瑰，九十九朵喔！
lines.simplified: 我还要送她巧克力跟一大束红玫瑰，九十九朵喔！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái yào sòng tā qiǎokèlì gēn yí dà shù hóng méigui, jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ o!
lines.english: I also want to send her chocolate and a big bunch of red roses, with ninety-nine flowers!

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 別忘了買蛋糕跟幾罐啤酒喔！
lines.simplified: 别忘了买蛋糕跟几罐啤酒喔！
lines.pinyin: Bié wàng le mǎi dàngāo gēn jǐ guàn píjiǔ o!
lines.english: Don't forget to buy a cake and a few cans of beer!

lines.speaker: 明生
lines.traditional: 那麼等可欣下課以後，我就告訴她這個好消息。
lines.simplified: 那么等可欣下课以后，我就告诉她这个好消息。
lines.pinyin: Nàme děng Kěxīn xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ jiù gàosu tā zhège hǎo xiāoxí.
lines.english: Well, when Kexin finishes her classes, I'll tell her this piece of good news.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something is finished and ready, or done well or badly.
grammarPages.explanation: 「好」放在動詞後面當結果補語，表示動作完成，而且結果理想。「V好了」說完成了、準備好了；「沒V好」說還沒完成；「V得好／V不好」說做得好或做得不好。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (還沒) + V + 好 (+ Object)

columns.pinyin: hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo
columns.meaning: have not finished your homework yet

columns.pinyin: zuò de hǎo zuò bu hǎo
columns.meaning: can do it well or not

text.traditional: 媽媽把明天要去野餐的東西都準備好了。
text.simplified: 妈妈把明天要去野餐的东西都准备好了。
text.pinyin: Māma bǎ míngtiān yào qù yěcān de dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
text.english: Mom has got everything for tomorrow's picnic ready.

words.pinyin: míngtiān yào qù yěcān de dōngxi

text.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
text.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
text.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bù néng chūqù tī zúqiú.
text.english: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

text.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
text.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
text.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshi nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bu hǎo.
text.english: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

text.traditional: 這份工作不簡單，你覺得他做得好做不好？
text.simplified: 这份工作不简单，你觉得他做得好做不好？
text.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò bù jiǎndān, nǐ juéde tā zuò de hǎo zuò bu hǎo?
text.english: This job is not easy. Do you think he can do it well or not?

words.pinyin: zuò de hǎo zuò bu hǎo
words.meaning: can do it well or not

items.question: 「V好了」和「V得好」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「V好了」說動作完成、準備好了；「V得好」說做得好不好。
items.wrongTraditional: 你還沒把功課寫得好，不能出去踢足球。
items.wrongSimplified: 你还没把功课写得好，不能出去踢足球。

right.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
right.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
right.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bù néng chūqù tī zúqiú.
right.english: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

words.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
words.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
words.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bù néng chūqù tī zúqiú.
words.meaning: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

items.question: 「學不好」的「不」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「好」前面，說結果不好；「不學好」是「不學」加「好」，意思不同。
items.wrongTraditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然不學好。
items.wrongSimplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然不学好。

right.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
right.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
right.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshi nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bu hǎo.
right.english: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

words.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
words.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
words.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshi nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bu hǎo.
words.meaning: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 媽媽把明天要去野餐的東西都

questions.correctFeedback: 「準備好了」表示東西都準備完成，可以出發了。
questions.repairFeedback: 「準備得」後面要接結果或評語；這裡說動作完成，用「準備好」。

practice.title: Practice: V好（V好了／沒V好／V得好／V不好）

items.prompt: The internet in your new home works now, so you can go online and play games. Say it with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 新家的網路可以用，你可以上網玩遊戲了。用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 新家的网络可以用，你可以上网玩游戏了。用「好」说。

repairs.note: 好嗎 makes a question; here you say the internet is ready.
壞了 means broken; the internet works now.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 網路 + 裝好了 + ，我可以上網玩遊戲了。

result.traditional: 網路裝好了，我可以上網玩遊戲了。
result.simplified: 网络装好了，我可以上网玩游戏了。
result.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhuāng hǎo le, wǒ kěyǐ shàngwǎng wán yóuxì le.
result.english: The internet is set up, so I can go online and play games.

alternatives.traditional: 網路弄好了，我可以上網玩遊戲了。
alternatives.simplified: 网络弄好了，我可以上网玩游戏了。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǎnglù nòng hǎo le, wǒ kěyǐ shàngwǎng wán yóuxì le.
alternatives.english: The internet is set up, so I can go online and play games.

items.successNote: V好了 says the action is finished and ready.

items.prompt: The materials for tomorrow’s meeting are not ready yet. Ask what to do, with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 明天開會要用的資料還沒好，怎麼辦？用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 明天开会要用的资料还没好，怎么办？用「好」说。

segments.traditional: 明天開會要用的資料，我還沒
segments.simplified: 明天开会要用的资料，我还没

repairs.note: V得 needs a comment after it; here the materials are not ready.
準備錯 means prepared the wrong thing; they are just not ready.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我還沒 + 準備好 + ，怎麼辦？

result.traditional: 明天開會要用的資料，我還沒準備好，怎麼辦？
result.simplified: 明天开会要用的资料，我还没准备好，怎么办？
result.pinyin: Míngtiān kāihuì yào yòng de zīliào, wǒ hái méi zhǔnbèi hǎo, zěnme bàn?
result.english: I haven't got the materials for tomorrow's meeting ready yet. What should I do?

items.successNote: 還沒V好: not finished and ready yet.

items.prompt: I heard Chinese is not easy. Do you think one year is enough? Say it with V得好.

promptZh.traditional: 聽說學中文不容易。你覺得一年夠嗎？用「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 听说学中文不容易。你觉得一年够吗？用「得」说。

segments.traditional: 聽說學中文不容易，一年
segments.simplified: 听说学中文不容易，一年

repairs.note: The question asks whether you can learn it well, not about a bad result.
好學 describes a subject as easy to learn; here you ask how well someone can learn it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一年 + 學得好 + 嗎？

result.traditional: 聽說學中文不容易，一年學得好嗎？
result.simplified: 听说学中文不容易，一年学得好吗？
result.pinyin: Tīngshuō xué Zhōngwén bù róngyì, yì nián xué de hǎo ma?
result.english: I heard Chinese is not easy. Can you learn it well in one year?

items.successNote: V得好 asks how well an action is done.

items.prompt: It is his first time singing this song. Say the result with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 他第一次唱這首歌。用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他第一次唱这首歌。用「好」说。

segments.traditional: 他第一次唱這首歌，所以還
segments.simplified: 他第一次唱这首歌，所以还

repairs.note: It is his first time, so he does not sing it well.
唱好 means finish singing; 還 shows the result is not good yet.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 所以還 + 唱不好.

result.traditional: 他第一次唱這首歌，所以還唱不好。
result.simplified: 他第一次唱这首歌，所以还唱不好。
result.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chàng zhè shǒu gē, suǒyǐ hái chàng bu hǎo.
result.english: It is his first time singing this song, so he still cannot sing it well.

items.successNote: V不好 says the result of the action is not good.

items.prompt: Dinner is ready, so you can eat. Say it with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 晚飯可以吃了。用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 晚饭可以吃了。用「好」说。

sentence.traditional: 晚飯做好了，可以吃。
sentence.simplified: 晚饭做好了，可以吃。
sentence.pinyin: Wǎnfàn zuò hǎo le, kěyǐ chī.
sentence.english: Dinner is ready, so you can eat.

repairs.note: 吃完 means finish eating; dinner is only ready now.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 晚飯 + 做好 + 了 + 可以 + 吃.
items.successNote: 做好 says the cooking is finished and the food is ready.

items.prompt: He sings beautifully, so everyone likes listening. Say it with V得 + comment.

promptZh.traditional: 他唱歌很好聽，大家喜歡聽。用「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他唱歌很好听，大家喜欢听。用「得」说。

sentence.traditional: 他唱得好，大家喜歡聽。
sentence.simplified: 他唱得好，大家喜欢听。
sentence.pinyin: Tā chàng de hǎo, dàjiā xǐhuān tīng.
sentence.english: He sings well, so everyone likes listening.

repairs.note: 唱好 means finish singing, not sing well.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 他 + 唱得 + 好 + 大家 + 喜歡聽.
items.successNote: V得好 + comment judges how well the action is done.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone did something wrong, or did not do it wrong.
grammarPages.explanation: 「錯」放在動詞後面當結果補語，表示動作的結果是錯的。「V錯了」說做了，可是做錯了；「沒V錯」說沒有做錯。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (沒) + V + 錯 (+ Object)

subsections.title: V錯了: did something wrong
subsections.explanation: 「錯」放在動詞後面，表示動作的結果是錯的；後面可以接受詞。

subsections.title: 沒V錯: did not do something wrong
subsections.explanation: 「沒」放在動詞前面，表示沒有做錯；不要再用「了」。

text.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。
text.simplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你听错了。
text.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānsheng bú shì Wáng xiānsheng, nǐ tīng cuò le.
text.english: He is Mr. Huang, not Mr. Wang; you heard wrong.

text.traditional: 今天早上我坐錯了車，所以上班遲到了。
text.simplified: 今天早上我坐错了车，所以上班迟到了。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ zuò cuò le chē, suǒyǐ shàngbān chídào le.
text.english: This morning I took the wrong bus, so I was late for work.

text.traditional: A：我們要去看的演唱會是下個星期六不是這個星期六。B：真的嗎？我記錯了時間嗎？
text.simplified: A：我们要去看的演唱会是下个星期六不是这个星期六。B：真的吗？我记错了时间吗？
text.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào qù kàn de yǎnchànghuì shì xià ge xīngqīliù bú shì zhège xīngqīliù. B: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān ma?
text.english: A: The concert we're going to is next Saturday, not this Saturday. B: Really? Did I remember the time wrong?

words.pinyin: wǒmen yào qù kàn de yǎnchànghuì

text.traditional: 孩子沒做錯事，你為什麼要打他？
text.simplified: 孩子没做错事，你为什么要打他？
text.pinyin: Háizi méi zuò cuò shì, nǐ wèishénme yào dǎ tā?
text.english: The child didn't do anything wrong; why do you want to hit him?

text.traditional: A：你吃了什麼？為什麼肚子疼呢？B：醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。
text.simplified: A：你吃了什么？为什么肚子疼呢？B：医生说我没吃错东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ chī le shénme? Wèishénme dùzi téng ne? B: Yīshēng shuō wǒ méi chī cuò dōngxi, kěnéng shì yǐnliào bù xīnxiān.
text.english: A: What did you eat? Why does your stomach hurt? B: The doctor said I didn't eat the wrong thing; maybe the drink wasn't fresh.

text.traditional: A：你沒聽錯，李小姐真的明天要結婚了。B：可是她說她沒有男朋友啊！
text.simplified: A：你没听错，李小姐真的明天要结婚了。B：可是她说她没有男朋友啊！
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ méi tīng cuò, Lǐ xiǎojiě zhēn de míngtiān yào jiéhūn le. B: Kěshì tā shuō tā méiyǒu nánpéngyou a!
text.english: A: You didn't hear wrong; Miss Li really is getting married tomorrow. B: But she said she doesn't have a boyfriend!

items.question: 「V錯了」的「錯」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在動詞後面，說動作的結果錯了；不能放在動詞前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你錯聽了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你错听了。

right.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。
right.simplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你听错了。
right.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānsheng bú shì Wáng xiānsheng, nǐ tīng cuò le.
right.english: He is Mr. Huang, not Mr. Wang; you heard wrong.

words.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。
words.simplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你听错了。
words.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānsheng bú shì Wáng xiānsheng, nǐ tīng cuò le.
words.meaning: He is Mr. Huang, not Mr. Wang; you heard wrong.

items.question: 「沒V錯」後面可以加「了」嗎？
items.answer: 不可以。「沒」已經表示否定，後面不再用「了」。
items.wrongTraditional: 醫生說我沒吃錯了東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。
items.wrongSimplified: 医生说我没吃错了东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。

right.traditional: 醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。
right.simplified: 医生说我没吃错东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。
right.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ méi chī cuò dōngxi, kěnéng shì yǐnliào bù xīnxiān.
right.english: The doctor said I didn't eat the wrong thing; maybe the drink wasn't fresh.

words.traditional: 醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。
words.simplified: 医生说我没吃错东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。
words.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ méi chī cuò dōngxi, kěnéng shì yǐnliào bù xīnxiān.
words.meaning: The doctor said I didn't eat the wrong thing; maybe the drink wasn't fresh.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你

questions.correctFeedback: 「聽錯了」表示聽到的人不對，結果是錯的。
questions.repairFeedback: 「聽好」是仔細聽；這裡說認錯人，用「聽錯」。

items.prompt: This is bus 99, not bus 299. Tell your friend with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 這是99公車，不是299公車。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这是99公车，不是299公车。用「错」说。

repairs.note: Add 了: the wrong bus is already a finished result.
坐得好 means sat well; the bus is the wrong one.
坐好了 means seated and ready, not the wrong bus.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你 + 坐錯了.

result.traditional: 這是99公車，不是299公車，你坐錯了。
result.simplified: 这是99公车，不是299公车，你坐错了。
result.pinyin: Zhè shì jiǔshíjiǔ gōngchē, bú shì èr bǎi jiǔshíjiǔ gōngchē, nǐ zuò cuò le.
result.english: This is bus 99, not bus 299; you took the wrong bus.

items.successNote: V錯了 says the action was done with a wrong result.

items.prompt: The map is not clear. What may happen if you walk by it? Say it with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚。看這張地圖走，會有什麼問題？用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这张地图不清楚。看这张地图走，会有什么问题？用「错」说。

segments.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚，要是你看著地圖走，可能會
segments.simplified: 这张地图不清楚，要是你看着地图走，可能会

repairs.note: 走好 means walk properly; the map leads you the wrong way.
You are walking, not taking a vehicle.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 可能會 + 走錯路.

result.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚，要是你看著地圖走，可能會走錯路。
result.simplified: 这张地图不清楚，要是你看着地图走，可能会走错路。
result.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú bù qīngchǔ, yàoshi nǐ kànzhe dìtú zǒu, kěnéng huì zǒu cuò lù.
result.english: This map is not clear. If you walk by it, you may take the wrong way.

alternatives.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚，要是你看著地圖走，可能會走錯。
alternatives.simplified: 这张地图不清楚，要是你看着地图走，可能会走错。
alternatives.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú bù qīngchǔ, yàoshi nǐ kànzhe dìtú zǒu, kěnéng huì zǒu cuò.
alternatives.english: This map is not clear. If you walk by it, you may go the wrong way.

items.successNote: V錯 + object names the wrong result.

items.prompt: The address on this letter is wrong. Complete both blanks with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 這封信的地址不對。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这封信的地址不对。用「错」说。

repairs.note: The address was written wrong; 送錯 belongs in the second blank.
寫錯 belongs in the first blank; the post office delivered it wrong.
寫好 means finished writing; the address itself is wrong.
送好 means delivered properly; 所以 shows the delivery went wrong.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 地址 + 寫錯 + 了，所以郵局的人就 + 送錯 + 了地方.

result.traditional: 這封信的地址寫錯了，所以郵局的人就送錯了地方。
result.simplified: 这封信的地址写错了，所以邮局的人就送错了地方。
result.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn de dìzhǐ xiě cuò le, suǒyǐ yóujú de rén jiù sòng cuò le dìfāng.
result.english: The address on this letter was written wrong, so the post office delivered it to the wrong place.

items.successNote: Each action gets its own V錯 result.

items.prompt: The husband cannot get into his house. Complete what he says with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 先生站在門口，進不去。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 先生站在门口，进不去。用「错」说。

items.sub: 太太：你怎麼站在門口，不進去呢？

segments.traditional: 了鑰匙，進不去，還好你回來了。
segments.simplified: 了钥匙，进不去，还好你回来了。

repairs.note: 拿好 means holding it properly; the key is the wrong one.
帶好 means brought it properly; he could not get in.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我出門的時候 + 拿錯 + 了鑰匙.

result.traditional: 我出門的時候拿錯了鑰匙，進不去，還好你回來了。
result.simplified: 我出门的时候拿错了钥匙，进不去，还好你回来了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ chūmén de shíhou ná cuò le yàoshi, jìn bu qù, hái hǎo nǐ huílái le.
result.english: I took the wrong key when I went out and could not get in. Good thing you are back.

alternatives.traditional: 我出門的時候帶錯了鑰匙，進不去，還好你回來了。
alternatives.simplified: 我出门的时候带错了钥匙，进不去，还好你回来了。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ chūmén de shíhou dài cuò le yàoshi, jìn bu qù, hái hǎo nǐ huílái le.
alternatives.english: I brought the wrong key when I went out and could not get in. Good thing you are back.

items.successNote: V錯了 + 了 marks a finished action with a wrong result.

items.prompt: Your friend invites you to KTV, but you do not want to go. Complete your reply with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友找你去KTV，你不想去。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友找你去KTV，你不想去。用「错」说。

items.sub: A：我們去KTV唱歌吧！

repairs.note: You are afraid of singing wrong, not of singing well.
V得 needs a comment after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我怕 + 唱錯 + 會被你們笑.

result.traditional: 我不去，我怕唱錯會被你們笑。
result.simplified: 我不去，我怕唱错会被你们笑。
result.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù, wǒ pà chàng cuò huì bèi nǐmen xiào.
result.english: I am not going. I am afraid I will sing wrong and you will laugh at me.

items.successNote: V錯 can stand alone before a consequence.

items.prompt: It is extremely hot today. Ask your friend with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 今天熱得不得了。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 今天热得不得了。用「错」说。

items.sub: B：我早上出門的時候覺得有一點兒冷，沒想到現在這麼熱。

segments.traditional: 衣服了？今天熱得不得了！
segments.simplified: 衣服了？今天热得不得了！

repairs.note: 穿好 means dressed; the problem is the wrong clothes.
V得 needs a comment after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你是不是 + 穿錯 + 衣服了？

result.traditional: 你是不是穿錯衣服了？今天熱得不得了！
result.simplified: 你是不是穿错衣服了？今天热得不得了！
result.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì chuān cuò yīfu le? Jīntiān rè de bùdéliǎo!
result.english: Did you put on the wrong clothes? It is extremely hot today!

items.successNote: V錯 names the action that produced the wrong result.

items.prompt: You were late. Say why, with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 你遲到了，因為時間不對。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你迟到了，因为时间不对。用「错」说。

sentence.traditional: 我記錯了時間，所以遲到了。
sentence.simplified: 我记错了时间，所以迟到了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le.
sentence.english: I remembered the time wrong, so I was late.

repairs.note: 但是 marks contrast; being late is the result, so use 所以.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我 + 記錯了 + 時間 + 所以 + 遲到了.
items.successNote: V錯了 + object states what was done wrong.

items.prompt: Your friend is afraid you got his birthday wrong. Reassure him with 沒V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友怕你記錯他的生日。用「沒……錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友怕你记错他的生日。用「没……错」说。

repairs.note: Do not use 了 after 沒: say 沒記錯.
記好 means remembered it well; here you say you did not get it wrong.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我沒 + 記錯.

result.traditional: 別擔心，我沒記錯，明天真的是他的生日。
result.simplified: 别担心，我没记错，明天真的是他的生日。
result.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, wǒ méi jì cuò, míngtiān zhēn de shì tā de shēngrì.
result.english: Don't worry, I did not get it wrong. Tomorrow really is his birthday.

items.successNote: 沒V錯 is negative and never takes 了.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: V會: learning and teaching to mastery
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone learned or taught a skill successfully.
grammarPages.explanation: 「會」放在動詞後面當結果補語，表示透過學習或教導得到某種能力。這個句型常用「學」和「教」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (沒 / V得 / V不) + 會 (+ Object)

columns.pinyin: xué le yí ge yuè jiù xuéhuì le
bàba jiāo de huì jiāo bu huì tā
columns.meaning: can his dad teach him or not

text.traditional: 我學游泳，學了一個月就學會了。
text.simplified: 我学游泳，学了一个月就学会了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué yóuyǒng, xué le yí ge yuè jiù xuéhuì le.
text.english: I learned to swim; after a month of learning, I had learned it.

text.traditional: 那個外國人還沒學會用筷子吃飯。
text.simplified: 那个外国人还没学会用筷子吃饭。
text.pinyin: Nàge wàiguórén hái méi xuéhuì yòng kuàizi chīfàn.
text.english: That foreigner still hasn't learned to eat with chopsticks.

text.traditional: 這首中文歌很容易，誰都學得會。
text.simplified: 这首中文歌很容易，谁都学得会。
text.pinyin: Zhè shǒu Zhōngwén gē hěn róngyì, shéi dōu xué de huì.

items.question: 「學會」和「學得會」有什麼不同？
items.answer: 「學會了」說已經學會；「學得會」說有能力學會。
items.wrongTraditional: 我學游泳，學了一個月就學得會了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我学游泳，学了一个月就学得会了。

right.traditional: 我學游泳，學了一個月就學會了。
right.simplified: 我学游泳，学了一个月就学会了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xué yóuyǒng, xué le yí ge yuè jiù xuéhuì le.
right.english: I learned to swim; after a month of learning, I had learned it.

words.traditional: 我學游泳，學了一個月就學會了。
words.simplified: 我学游泳，学了一个月就学会了。
words.pinyin: Wǒ xué yóuyǒng, xué le yí ge yuè jiù xuéhuì le.
words.meaning: I learned to swim; after a month of learning, I had learned it.

items.question: 「教不會」的「不」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「會」前面；否定的是結果，不是「教」。

items.wrongSimplified: 那个孩子那么小，爸爸不会教他怎么骑脚踏车。

right.traditional: 那個孩子那麼小，爸爸教不會他怎麼騎腳踏車。
right.simplified: 那个孩子那么小，爸爸教不会他怎么骑脚踏车。
right.pinyin: Nàge háizi nàme xiǎo, bàba jiāo bu huì tā zěnme qí jiǎotàchē.
right.english: That child is so small; his father cannot teach him how to ride a bike.

words.traditional: 那個孩子那麼小，爸爸教不會他怎麼騎腳踏車。
words.simplified: 那个孩子那么小，爸爸教不会他怎么骑脚踏车。

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我學游泳，學了一個月就

questions.repairFeedback: 「學好」說學得很好；這裡說一個月就得到游泳的能力，用「學會」。

practice.title: Practice: V會（V會了／沒V會／V得會／V不會）

items.prompt: This dance is hard. After two days of trying, I still have not learned it. Say it with 沒V會.

promptZh.traditional: 這個舞好難。我學了兩天，一點兒也不會。用「沒……會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这个舞好难。我学了两天，一点儿也不会。用「没……会」说。

segments.traditional: 這個舞好難，我學了兩天，還是
segments.simplified: 这个舞好难，我学了两天，还是

repairs.note: 學會了 says he did learn it; 還是 shows he did not.
The task asks for 沒……會: 沒學會.
沒學好 means not learned well; he cannot do it at all, so 沒學會.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還是 + 沒學會.

result.traditional: 這個舞好難，我學了兩天，還是沒學會。
result.simplified: 这个舞好难，我学了两天，还是没学会。
result.pinyin: Zhège wǔ hǎo nán, wǒ xué le liǎng tiān, háishì méi xuéhuì.
result.english: This dance is hard. I learned it for two days and still have not mastered it.

items.successNote: 沒學會 says the result was not achieved.

items.prompt: On the first day of class, the teacher taught me how to write my Chinese name. Say it with V會.

promptZh.traditional: 上課的第一天，老師教我寫自己的中文名字。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 上课的第一天，老师教我写自己的中文名字。用「会」说。

segments.traditional: 我怎麼寫自己的中文名字了。
segments.simplified: 我怎么写自己的中文名字了。

repairs.note: 教得 needs a comment after it.
教錯 means taught it wrong; he learned to write it.
學會 is what the student did; the teacher 教會 him.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 老師就 + 教會 + 我怎麼寫自己的中文名字了.

result.traditional: 上課的第一天，老師就教會我怎麼寫自己的中文名字了。
result.simplified: 上课的第一天，老师就教会我怎么写自己的中文名字了。
result.pinyin: Shàngkè de dì yī tiān, lǎoshī jiù jiāo huì wǒ zěnme xiě zìjǐ de Zhōngwén míngzi le.
result.english: On the first day of class, the teacher taught me how to write my own Chinese name.

items.successNote: 教會 says the teaching succeeded.

items.prompt: No one taught you to play soccer, but you can play. Ask how you learned it, with V會.

promptZh.traditional: 沒有人教你踢足球，可是你會踢。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 没有人教你踢足球，可是你会踢。用「会」说。

sentence.traditional: 沒有人教你踢足球，你自己怎麼學會的？
sentence.simplified: 没有人教你踢足球，你自己怎么学会的？
sentence.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén jiāo nǐ tī zúqiú, nǐ zìjǐ zěnme xuéhuì de?
sentence.english: No one taught you to play soccer. How did you learn it yourself?

sentence.traditional: 沒有人教你踢足球，你自己怎麼學得會的？
sentence.simplified: 没有人教你踢足球，你自己怎么学得会的？
sentence.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén jiāo nǐ tī zúqiú, nǐ zìjǐ zěnme xué de huì de?
sentence.english: No one taught you to play soccer. How did you manage to learn it yourself?

repairs.note: 怎麼V會……的 asks how; 學會了 states the result.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你自己 + 怎麼 + 學會 + 的？
items.successNote: 怎麼V會…的 asks how an achievement happened.

items.prompt: You want driving lessons. Complete both lines with V會.

promptZh.traditional: 你想請朋友教你開車。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你想请朋友教你开车。用「会」说。

segments.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月
segments.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月

segments.traditional: 要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就
segments.simplified: 要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就

repairs.note: Use 學得會 to ask whether you can learn it; 學會了 says it is already done.
You have not started; the question is whether you can learn it.
The second blank is about you learning, not about teaching.
B says you will learn it, so 沒學會 is the opposite.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一個月 + 學得會 + 嗎？也許兩個星期就 + 學會了.

result.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月學得會嗎？要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就學會了。
result.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月学得会吗？要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就学会了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ jiāo wǒ kāichē, yí ge yuè xué de huì ma? Yàoshi nǐ měi tiān liànxí, yěxǔ liǎng ge xīngqī jiù xuéhuì le.
result.english: I want you to teach me to drive. Can I learn it in a month? If you practice every day, maybe you will learn it in two weeks.

items.successNote: V得會 asks about the ability; V會了 states the achieved result.

items.prompt: That child is too young. Say it with 會.

promptZh.traditional: 那個孩子太小了。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 那个孩子太小了。用「会」说。

repairs.note: The child is too young; the teacher cannot teach him.
教會了 says the teacher succeeded; 太小 gives the opposite.

items.prompt: This book is too hard for the child. Say it with 會.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that any person, thing, place, or way will do.
grammarPages.explanation: 兩個相同的疑問詞前後呼應，表示沒有特別的限制；前面的條件成立，後面的動作就跟著發生。疑問詞可以是誰、什麼、哪裡、幾、哪、怎麼等。

right.traditional: 他很有錢，想買什麼就買什麼。

words.traditional: 他很有錢，想買什麼就買什麼。

words.traditional: 這個巧克力，誰想吃誰就吃。

words.pinyin: Zhège qiǎokèlì, shéi xiǎng chī shéi jiù chī.
words.meaning: Whoever wants to eat this chocolate can eat it.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 前後要用同一個疑問詞「什麼」。
questions.repairFeedback: 「買哪個」要用「哪個」呼應；這裡前面是「什麼」，後面也要用「什麼」。

items.prompt: No work tomorrow. Say you will get up whenever you want, with 幾點……就……幾點.

promptZh.traditional: 明天不用上班，你想幾點起床都可以。用「幾點……就……幾點」說。
promptZh.simplified: 明天不用上班，你想几点起床都可以。用「几点……就……几点」说。

sentence.traditional: 明天不用上班，想幾點起床就幾點起床。
sentence.simplified: 明天不用上班，想几点起床就几点起床。
sentence.pinyin: Míngtiān búyòng shàngbān, xiǎng jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng jiù jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 想幾點 + 起床 + 就 + 幾點 + 起床.

items.prompt: A friend asks which drink you want. Answer with 哪一種……就……哪一種 and 好喝; the book prints 只要不太甜的就好 after the blank.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友問你要喝哪一種飲料。用「好喝」和「哪一種……就……哪一種」說；最後有「只要不太甜的就好」。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友问你要喝哪一种饮料。用「好喝」和「哪一种……就……哪一种」说；最后有「只要不太甜的就好」。

items.sub: A：這些飲料都很好喝，你要喝哪一種？

sentence.traditional: 哪一種好喝就喝哪一種。
sentence.simplified: 哪一种好喝就喝哪一种。
sentence.pinyin: Nǎ yì zhǒng hǎohē jiù hē nǎ yì zhǒng.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 哪一種 + 好喝 + 就 + 喝 + 哪一種.
items.successNote: This is the 哪一種……就……哪一種 clause; the book then adds 只要不太甜的就好.

items.prompt: A shop sells lanterns in many colors. You may buy whichever one you want. Say it with 哪一個……就……哪一個.

items.sub: A：那家商店賣很多不同顏色的燈籠，你想買哪一個？

items.fallbackRepair: Say 哪一個 + 好看 + 就 + 買 + 哪一個.

items.prompt: A friend asks whether to roast or fry the chicken. It is up to them; say it with 怎麼做……就……怎麼做.

promptZh.simplified: 朋友问你这块鸡肉要烤还是炸。你想怎么做都可以。用「怎么做……就……怎么做」说。

items.sub: A：這塊雞肉要怎麼做？烤還是炸？

sentence.traditional: 你想怎麼做就怎麼做。
sentence.simplified: 你想怎么做就怎么做。

items.prompt: There are many flights to the US this weekend. You may take whichever one you want. Say it with 哪一班……就……哪一班.

items.sub: A：週末從台灣飛往美國的飛機一共有八班，你要搭哪一班？

items.prompt: At dinner, the first person to come eats first. Say it with 誰……誰就…….

sentence.traditional: 什麼時候有空就什麼時候來。

sentence.pinyin: Shénme shíhou yǒukòng jiù shénme shíhou lái.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 什麼時候 + 有空 + 就 + 什麼時候 + 來.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Assure someone that something will very likely happen.
grammarPages.explanation: 這個句型表示說話者相信後面的情況很可能發生；「的」放在句尾，語氣比較肯定、緩和。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 會 + …… + 的

columns.traditional: 畢業後一定會找到好工作的
columns.simplified: 毕业后一定会找到好工作的
columns.pinyin: bìyè hòu yídìng huì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò de
columns.meaning: will definitely find a good job after graduation

columns.pinyin: hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de

text.traditional: 李小姐的成績很好，畢業後一定會找到好工作的。
text.simplified: 李小姐的成绩很好，毕业后一定会找到好工作的。

text.traditional: 醫生說，多休息、多喝水，我的感冒很快就會好的。
text.simplified: 医生说，多休息、多喝水，我的感冒很快就会好的。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, duō xiūxi, duō hē shuǐ, wǒ de gǎnmào hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de.
text.english: The doctor said that with more rest and more water, my cold will get better very soon.

words.pinyin: hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de

text.traditional: A：我很想去法國留學，可是怕父母不同意。B：只要好好地跟他們說，他們不會不同意的。
text.simplified: A：我很想去法国留学，可是怕父母不同意。B：只要好好地跟他们说，他们不会不同意的。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù Fǎguó liúxué, kěshì pà fùmǔ bù tóngyì. B: Zhǐyào hǎohǎo de gēn tāmen shuō, tāmen bú huì bù tóngyì de.
text.english: A: I really want to study abroad in France, but I'm afraid my parents won't agree. B: As long as you talk to them nicely, they won't disagree.

items.question: 「會……的」的「的」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 「的」放在句尾，表示說話者很肯定，語氣也比較緩和。
items.wrongTraditional: 他一定會的找到好工作。
items.wrongSimplified: 他一定会的找到好工作。

right.traditional: 他一定會找到好工作的。
right.simplified: 他一定会找到好工作的。
right.pinyin: Tā yídìng huì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò de.
right.english: He will definitely find a good job.

words.traditional: 他一定會找到好工作的。
words.simplified: 他一定会找到好工作的。
words.pinyin: Tā yídìng huì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò de.
words.meaning: He will definitely find a good job.

items.question: 「不會不同意」是什麼意思？
items.answer: 這是雙重否定，表示「會同意」。
items.wrongTraditional: 只要好好地跟他們說，他們不會同意。
items.wrongSimplified: 只要好好地跟他们说，他们不会同意。

right.traditional: 只要好好地跟他們說，他們不會不同意的。
right.simplified: 只要好好地跟他们说，他们不会不同意的。
right.pinyin: Zhǐyào hǎohǎo de gēn tāmen shuō, tāmen bú huì bù tóngyì de.
right.english: As long as you talk to them nicely, they will not disagree.

words.traditional: 只要好好地跟他們說，他們不會不同意的。
words.simplified: 只要好好地跟他们说，他们不会不同意的。
words.pinyin: Zhǐyào hǎohǎo de gēn tāmen shuō, tāmen bú huì bù tóngyì de.
words.meaning: As long as you talk to them nicely, they will not disagree.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 醫生說，多休息、多喝水，我的感冒很快就會

questions.correctFeedback: 「會……的」用「的」結尾，表示肯定的語氣。
questions.repairFeedback: 這裡不是問句，也不用「得」或「吧」；「會……的」用「的」結尾。

items.prompt: The parking lot has no security staff. Say it with 會……的.

promptZh.traditional: 那個停車場沒有安全人員。用「會……的」說。
promptZh.simplified: 那个停车场没有安全人员。用「会……的」说。

segments.traditional: 那個停車場沒有安全人員，你的車停在那裡
segments.simplified: 那个停车场没有安全人员，你的车停在那里

repairs.note: 會偷的 says your car will steal; 被 marks the car as the thing stolen.
被偷了 states it was stolen; 會……的 gives the assurance it will happen.
會偷 lacks 的 and says the car steals.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你的車停在那裡 + 會被偷的.

result.traditional: 那個停車場沒有安全人員，你的車停在那裡會被偷的。
result.simplified: 那个停车场没有安全人员，你的车停在那里会被偷的。
result.pinyin: Nàge tíngchēchǎng méi yǒu ānquán rényuán, nǐ de chē tíng zài nàlǐ huì bèi tōu de.
result.english: That parking lot has no security staff; your car will be stolen if you park it there.

items.successNote: 會……的 gives a confident prediction.

items.prompt: Your friend is afraid it will rain, but the forecast says it will be sunny. Answer with 會……的.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友怕週末下雨，可是聽說週末是晴天。用「會……的」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友怕周末下雨，可是听说周末是晴天。用「会……的」说。

items.sub: A：週末我想去山上野餐，不知道會不會下雨？

repairs.note: The forecast is sunny, so the prediction is negative: 不會.
Use 不會 + 下雨的, not 不下雨的.
Put 不會 before 下雨的.
The forecast is sunny, so it will not rain.
Use 不會 + 下雨的, not 不下雨的.
不會 goes before 下雨的, not after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 不會 + 下雨的.

result.traditional: 聽說週末是晴天，不會下雨的。
result.simplified: 听说周末是晴天，不会下雨的。
result.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhōumò shì qíngtiān, bú huì xiàyǔ de.
result.english: I heard it will be sunny this weekend, so it will not rain.

items.successNote: 不會……的 reassures that something will not happen.

items.prompt: Your brother worries his girlfriend may not like the perfume. Reassure him with 會……的.

promptZh.traditional: 哥哥怕女朋友不喜歡香水。用「會……的」說。
promptZh.simplified: 哥哥怕女朋友不喜欢香水。用「会……的」说。

items.sub: 哥哥：我買了一瓶香水要送給女朋友，不知道她喜歡不喜歡？

repairs.note: She loves you, so she will like it; 不會喜歡 is the opposite.
Use 的 at the end of 會……的, not 了.
Put 一定 in the first blank and 會喜歡的 in the second.
一定 goes before 會喜歡的, not after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一定 + 會喜歡的.

result.traditional: 她那麼愛你，一定會喜歡的。
result.simplified: 她那么爱你，一定会喜欢的。
result.pinyin: Tā nàme ài nǐ, yídìng huì xǐhuān de.
result.english: She loves you so much; she will definitely like it.

items.successNote: 一定 + 會……的 makes the assurance stronger.

items.prompt: You are ready for tomorrow’s exam. Say it with 會……的.

promptZh.traditional: 明天要考試，你已經準備好了。用「會……的」說。
promptZh.simplified: 明天要考试，你已经准备好了。用「会……的」说。

repairs.note: You are ready, so the prediction is positive.
Use 的 at the end of 會……的, not 得.
Add 會: 會考好的.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一定 + 會考好的.

result.traditional: 你已經準備好了，一定會考好的。
result.simplified: 你已经准备好了，一定会考好的。
result.pinyin: Nǐ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le, yídìng huì kǎo hǎo de.
result.english: You are already prepared; you will definitely do well on the exam.

items.successNote: 會 + result + 的 predicts a good result.

items.prompt: Your friend is afraid he will not come. Say it with 會……的.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友怕他不會來。用「會……的」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友怕他不会来。用「会……的」说。

sentence.traditional: 別擔心，他一定會來的。
sentence.simplified: 别担心，他一定会来的。
sentence.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, tā yídìng huì lái de.
sentence.english: Don't worry; he will definitely come.

sentence.traditional: 他一定會來的，別擔心。
sentence.simplified: 他一定会来的，别担心。
sentence.pinyin: Tā yídìng huì lái de, bié dānxīn.
sentence.english: He will definitely come; don’t worry.

repairs.note: 嗎 makes a question; this is a reassurance, so end with 的.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 別擔心 + 他 + 一定會 + 來的.
items.successNote: 會……的 softens a confident promise.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one thing happens right after another.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示前面的情況發生以後，後面的事情才發生。否定詞「不」和「沒」要放在「等」前面。
grammarPages.pattern: 等 + Situation, + Subject + 就 + Result

items.question: 「不」和「沒」放在「等」的哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「等」前面，不是「就」前面。

items.wrongSimplified: 有很多人等舞会没结束，就先走了。

right.traditional: 有很多人沒等舞會結束，就先走了。
right.simplified: 有很多人没等舞会结束，就先走了。
right.pinyin: Yǒu hěn duō rén méi děng wǔhuì jiéshù, jiù xiān zǒu le.
right.english: Many people left before the dance ended.

words.traditional: 有很多人沒等舞會結束，就先走了。
words.simplified: 有很多人没等舞会结束，就先走了。

words.meaning: Many people left before the dance ended.

items.question: 「就」放在哪裡？
items.answer: 「就」放在第二個主語後面、動作前面。

right.english: Once this semester ends, I won't live in the dormitory anymore.

words.traditional: 等這個學期結束，我就不要住在宿舍了。

words.pinyin: Děng zhège xuéqī jiéshù, wǒ jiù bú yào zhù zài sùshè le.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：
questions.correctFeedback: 「等……，就……」表示前面的情況發生後，後面接著發生。
questions.repairFeedback: 這裡只是接著發生，用「就」；「又」是再一次。

items.prompt: The child was so hungry. Complete the sentence with 等……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 孩子太餓了。用「等……就……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 孩子太饿了。用「等……就……」说。

segments.traditional: 爸爸回來，就先吃起飯來了。
segments.simplified: 爸爸回来，就先吃起饭来了。

repairs.note: 等得 needs a comment after it; here you need 沒等.
Without 沒, the sentence says he waited for dad, but he ate first.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沒等 + 爸爸回來，就先吃起飯來了.

result.traditional: 孩子太餓了，沒等爸爸回來，就先吃起飯來了。
result.simplified: 孩子太饿了，没等爸爸回来，就先吃起饭来了。
result.pinyin: Háizi tài è le, méi děng bàba huílái, jiù xiān chī qǐ fàn lái le.
result.english: The child was so hungry that he started eating before his dad came back.

items.successNote: Put 沒 before 等 to say someone did not wait.

items.prompt: A friend asks when you can get on the bus. Answer that you can after buying the tickets, with 等……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 朋友問你什麼時候可以上車。用「買好票」和「等……就……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友问你什么时候可以上车。用「买好票」和「等……就……」说。

items.sub: A：我們什麼時候可以上車？

sentence.traditional: 等買好票，就可以上車。
sentence.simplified: 等买好票，就可以上车。
sentence.pinyin: Děng mǎi hǎo piào, jiù kěyǐ shàngchē.
sentence.english: Once the tickets are bought, you can get on the bus.

repairs.note: 還 means still; here the result follows 等: 就.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 等 + 買好票 + 就 + 可以 + 上車.

items.prompt: A friend asks when the school will give the scholarship. Answer after the exams, with 等……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 朋友問學校什麼時候給獎學金。用「考完試」和「等……就……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友问学校什么时候给奖学金。用「考完试」和「等……就……」说。

sentence.simplified: 等考完试，就会给我们奖学金。
sentence.pinyin: Děng kǎo wán shì, jiù huì gěi wǒmen jiǎngxuéjīn.
sentence.english: Once the exams are over, they will give us the scholarship.

repairs.note: 又 means again; here the result follows 等: 就.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 等 + 考完試 + 就會 + 給我們 + 獎學金.

sentence.traditional: 等他下課，我們就去吃飯。
sentence.simplified: 等他下课，我们就去吃饭。
sentence.pinyin: Děng tā xiàkè, wǒmen jiù qù chīfàn.
sentence.english: After he finishes class, we will go eat.

sentence.traditional: 我們等他下課，就去吃飯。
sentence.simplified: 我们等他下课，就去吃饭。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒmen děng tā xiàkè, jiù qù chīfàn.
sentence.english: We'll go eat after he finishes class.

repairs.note: 也 means also; here the meal happens right after he finishes class.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 等他下課 + 我們 + 就 + 去 + 吃飯.

items.prompt: You are still young; you will understand when you grow up, with 等……就…….

promptZh.traditional: 你現在還小，長大以後就會了解。用「等……就……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你现在还小，长大以后就会了解。用「等……就……」说。

sentence.traditional: 等你長大，你就會了解。
sentence.simplified: 等你长大，你就会了解。
sentence.pinyin: Děng nǐ zhǎngdà, nǐ jiù huì liǎojiě.
sentence.english: When you grow up, you will understand.

repairs.note: 以前 means before; here 等 introduces the future condition.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 等你長大 + 你 + 就 + 會 + 了解.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在台灣，KTV是一個吃喝玩樂的好地方。很多人會到KTV過生日、辦活動；不少學生一考完試就去KTV唱歌、吃東西，讓自己輕鬆一下。有人家裡有卡拉OK的機器，不但想唱的時候隨時都能唱，也可以請朋友、鄰居一起來唱。
lines.simplified: 在台湾，KTV是一个吃喝玩乐的好地方。很多人会到KTV过生日、办活动；不少学生一考完试就去KTV唱歌、吃东西，让自己轻松一下。有人家里有卡拉OK的机器，不但想唱的时候随时都能唱，也可以请朋友、邻居一起来唱。
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, KTV shì yí ge chī hē wán lè de hǎo dìfāng. Hěn duō rén huì dào KTV guò shēngrì, bàn huódòng; bùshǎo xuésheng yì kǎo wán shì jiù qù KTV chànggē, chī dōngxi, ràng zìjǐ qīngsōng yíxià. Yǒu rén jiā lǐ yǒu kǎlā OK de jīqì, búdàn xiǎng chàng de shíhou suíshí dōu néng chàng, yě kěyǐ qǐng péngyou, línjū yìqǐ lái chàng.
lines.english: In Taiwan, KTV is a good place to eat, drink, and have fun. Many people will go to KTV bars to sing when they celebrate birthdays or organize activities. Many students go to KTV bars to sing, eat, and relax themselves right after exams. Some people also have karaoke sets at home. They can not only sing whenever they want but also invite their friends and neighbors to sing together.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 台灣的KTV是二十四小時的，你想什麼時候去唱歌都可以。不同的時間，價錢也不同，早上六點到中午十二點前最便宜，一個人才兩百多塊錢。週末、假日比平日貴得多，還常常客滿，所以很多大學生利用沒課時去KTV，不但省錢，也不需要排隊。
lines.simplified: 台湾的KTV是二十四小时的，你想什么时候去唱歌都可以。不同的时间，价钱也不同，早上六点到中午十二点前最便宜，一个人才两百多块钱。周末、假日比平日贵得多，还常常客满，所以很多大学生利用没课时去KTV，不但省钱，也不需要排队。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou qù chànggē dōu kěyǐ. Bùtóng de shíjiān, jiàqián yě bùtóng, zǎoshang liù diǎn dào zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián zuì piányi, yí ge rén cái liǎngbǎi duō kuài qián. Zhōumò, jiàrì bǐ píngrì guì de duō, hái chángcháng kèmǎn, suǒyǐ hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng méi kè shí qù KTV, búdàn shěng qián, yě bù xūyào páiduì.
lines.english: The KTV bars in Taiwan are open 24 hours a day. You can go there and sing whenever you want. The price is different for different times. From 6 am to 12:00 noon is the cheapest, only a bit over $200 for a person. Though weekends and holidays are much more expensive than weekdays, the bars are often full. Therefore, many university students use the time when they have no classes to go to KTV bars. Not only can they save money, but they also don't need to line up.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 台灣的KTV還有一個特色，就是有各式各樣的食物和飲料。只要你多付一點兒錢，就可以吃到飽，不必擔心唱著唱著就餓了。有的KTV還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。其實，也有人生氣或是傷心的時候，會自己一個人去KTV，一邊唱、一邊哭，等唱完以後，心情就好多了。
lines.simplified: 台湾的KTV还有一个特色，就是有各式各样的食物和饮料。只要你多付一点儿钱，就可以吃到饱，不必担心唱着唱着就饿了。有的KTV还有好玩的乐器，让客人唱得更开心。其实，也有人生气或是伤心的时候，会自己一个人去KTV，一边唱、一边哭，等唱完以后，心情就好多了。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV hái yǒu yí ge tèsè, jiùshì yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shíwù hé yǐnliào. Zhǐyào nǐ duō fù yìdiǎnr qián, jiù kěyǐ chīdàobǎo, búbì dānxīn chàngzhe chàngzhe jiù è le. Yǒu de KTV hái yǒu hǎowán de yuèqì, ràng kèrén chàng de gèng kāixīn. Qíshí, yě yǒu rén shēngqì huòshì shāngxīn de shíhou, huì zìjǐ yí ge rén qù KTV, yìbiān chàng, yìbiān kū, děng chàng wán yǐhòu, xīnqíng jiù hǎo duō le.
lines.english: Taiwanese KTV bars have another special feature—that is, a wide range of food and beverages. As long as you pay a little more, you can eat as much as you want. You do not have to worry that you'll get hungry while singing. Some KTV bars also have funny musical instruments, so that the guests can enjoy their singing more. Actually, there are also some people who go alone to a KTV bar when they are angry or sad. They cry while singing. When they finish singing, their moods become much better.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 要是你想慶祝生日，去KTV跟大家合唱，一定會很開心的；如果心情不好，去KTV自己一個人唱歌，也能把不愉快的事情忘了，所以去KTV真是一個不錯的選擇。
lines.simplified: 要是你想庆祝生日，去KTV跟大家合唱，一定会很开心的；如果心情不好，去KTV自己一个人唱歌，也能把不愉快的事情忘了，所以去KTV真是一个不错的选择。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng qìngzhù shēngrì, qù KTV gēn dàjiā héchàng, yídìng huì hěn kāixīn de; rúguǒ xīnqíng bù hǎo, qù KTV zìjǐ yí ge rén chànggē, yě néng bǎ bù yúkuài de shìqing wàng le, suǒyǐ qù KTV zhēn shì yí ge búcuò de xuǎnzé.
lines.english: If you want to celebrate your birthday, go to KTV bars to sing with people, you must be very happy; if you are in a bad mood, go to KTV bars to sing on your own, you can also forget the unpleasant things. So going to KTV bars is really a good choice.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Stress that a number is smaller than expected.
grammarPages.explanation: 「才」在這裡表示數量比說話者預期的少，和「只」都表示少，但「才」強調說話者的主觀感覺，而且可以直接放在數量詞前面。課本又說「只」放在動詞前面，後面不能接數量詞，並把「＊這件衣服只一百塊錢」標為錯誤；可是很多人也說「只一百塊錢」，課本這句話太絕對，這裡先記住「才＋數量詞」的用法。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 才 + Number (+ Measure word) + …

items.sub: A：你去過KTV幾次？

repairs.note: Put 才 before 去過一次: 我才去過一次.
Use 才 in the first blank and 去過一次 in the second.
Put 才 before 去過一次.
才 goes before 去過, not after it.
The frequency 一次 comes after 去過.
Add the frequency 一次 after 去過.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我 + 才 + 去過一次.

repairs.note: Add 才 to say only 300.

sentence.simplified: 我不喜欢坐飞机，一听到坐飞机就让我紧张得不得了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān zuò fēijī, yì tīngdào zuò fēijī jiù ràng wǒ jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo.
sentence.english: I do not like flying; just hearing about flying makes me extremely nervous.

repairs.note: 被 marks an action done to someone; here the flight causes the feeling, so use 讓.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 就讓 + 我 + 緊張 + 得不得了.
items.successNote: 讓 links a cause to a person's feeling.

items.prompt: Your mom is angry because of your room. Choose the right word to fix the sentence.

promptZh.traditional: 媽媽因為你的房間很生氣。這個句子不對，選一個對的。
promptZh.simplified: 妈妈因为你的房间很生气。这个句子不对，选一个对的。

repairs.note: 給媽媽 means for mom; here the room causes the feeling, so 讓媽媽.
對媽媽 means angry at mom, not making her angry.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; swap 把 for 讓: the room is the cause.
items.hint: The room causes the feeling; use the cause marker.

result.traditional: 我的房間讓媽媽很生氣。
result.simplified: 我的房间让妈妈很生气。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān ràng māma hěn shēngqì.
result.english: My room made my mom angry.

items.successNote: A 讓 B + feeling: A is the cause.

items.prompt: A thief stole your car, and you were very sad. Say it with 被 and 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 小偷偷了你的車，你很傷心。用「被」和「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 小偷偷了你的车，你很伤心。用「被」和「让」说。

items.sub: 小偷偷了你的車，你很傷心。

sentence.traditional: 我的車被偷了，讓我很傷心。
sentence.simplified: 我的车被偷了，让我很伤心。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de chē bèi tōu le, ràng wǒ hěn shāngxīn.
sentence.english: My car was stolen, which made me very sad.

repairs.note: 把 needs the doer first: 小偷把車偷了; here the car is the subject of 被.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我的車 + 被偷了 + 讓我 + 很傷心.
items.successNote: 被 marks what happened; 讓 marks the feeling it caused.
